items.title: Diagnosis, Rehabilitation, and Return to Sport after Athletic Hamstring Injury: An ICCUS Society Consensus Statement.
items.summary: An ICCUS Society expert consensus statement, developed via a modified Delphi process with 17 clinicians, achieved over 80% agreement on 54 statements concerning athletic hamstring injury management, emphasizing standardized classification, individualized criterion-based rehabilitation, progressive loading, and multi-faceted return-to-sport criteria.
items.curatedReason: 这份由17位专家达成80%以上共识的声明，为腘绳肌损伤管理提供了明确的指导方针。这意味着你应当推行标准化的分类、个性化且基于标准的康复方案，并采用多维度评估来决定运动员何时重返赛场。
items.titleZh: 运动性腘绳肌损伤的诊断、康复和重返运动：ICCUS学会共识声明
items.summaryZh: 一份由17位临床专家通过改良德尔菲法制定的ICCUS学会共识声明，在运动性腘绳肌损伤管理的54项声明上达成80%以上共识，强调了标准化分类、个体化基于标准的康复、渐进式负荷以及多方面重返运动标准的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This consensus, agreed upon by 17 experts with over 80% concordance, offers clear guidelines for hamstring injury management. You should adopt standardized classification, implement individualized and criterion-based rehabilitation, and utilize multi-faceted assessments for return-to-sport decisions.
items.limitation: 德尔菲共识依赖于专家意见，而非直接的随机对照试验数据，可能存在专家组自身偏倚。
items.limitationEn: Delphi consensus relies on expert opinions rather than direct randomized controlled trial data, which may introduce bias from the expert panel itself.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Gait variability as a predictor of fall risk in patients with stroke: A 6-month prospective cohort study with survival analysis.
items.summary: In a 6-month prospective cohort study of 112 stroke patients, stride time variability (STV) at discharge, with an optimal cutoff of 3.40% (AUC 0.756, sensitivity 88.2%, specificity 53.8%), was identified as the sole independent predictor of post-discharge falls, outperforming conventional measures.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究表明，卒中患者出院时的步幅时间变异性（STV）是预测其出院后6个月内跌倒风险的独立指标，其3.40%的截断值可辅助早期风险识别。这提示你在临床实践中应常规评估STV，并对高风险患者实施有针对性的跌倒预防干预。
items.titleZh: 步态变异性作为卒中患者跌倒风险预测指标：一项6个月随访的队列研究和生存分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对112名卒中患者进行6个月随访的前瞻性队列研究显示，出院时的步幅时间变异性（STV），以3.40%为最佳截断值（AUC 0.756，敏感性88.2%，特异性53.8%），是出院后跌倒的唯一独立预测因子，优于其他常规测量指标。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study indicates that stride time variability (STV) at discharge is an independent predictor of fall risk within 6 months post-discharge for stroke patients, with a 3.40% cutoff value aiding early risk identification. This suggests you should routinely assess STV in clinical practice and implement targeted fall prevention interventions for high-risk patients.
items.limitation: 该研究为单中心样本，可能限制了STV截断值的普适性，需要多中心验证。
items.limitationEn: The study's single-center sample may limit the generalizability of the STV cutoff value, requiring multi-center validation.

items.title: Neurocognitive Factors in ACL Injury: The Missing Piece in Rehabilitation and Prevention? A Scoping Review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 42 studies identified neurocognitive factors, particularly dual-task interference and visual attention, as significant missing components in ACL injury rehabilitation and prevention. It suggests integrating neurocognitive challenges into rehabilitation and return-to-sport testing to better identify secondary injury risk.
items.curatedReason: 这篇范围综述强调了神经认知因素在ACL损伤康复和预防中被忽视的重要性。你需要在康复和重返运动测试中更多地融入双任务干扰、视觉注意、反应时间等神经认知挑战，以更好地识别二次损伤风险。
items.titleZh: ACL损伤中的神经认知因素：康复和预防中缺失的一环？一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含42项研究的范围综述指出，神经认知因素，特别是双任务干扰和视觉注意，是ACL损伤康复和预防中被忽视的重要组成部分。该综述建议将神经认知挑战融入康复和重返运动测试，以更好地识别二次损伤风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review highlights the overlooked importance of neurocognitive factors in ACL injury rehabilitation and prevention. You need to integrate neurocognitive challenges like dual-task interference, visual attention, and reaction time more into rehabilitation and return-to-sport testing to better identify risks for secondary injury.
items.limitation: 这是一篇范围综述，纳入的研究证据等级较低，多为实验室探索性研究，临床转化数据有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review, and the included studies often have a low level of evidence, consisting mostly of exploratory lab-based research with limited clinical translational data.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Feasibility, Safety, and Preliminary Effect Estimates of an Ultrasound-Informed Hybrid Joint-Sparing Rehabilitation Strategy in Patients With Rheumatoid Arthritis: A Prospective Non-Randomized Proof-of-Concept Study.
items.summary: A 12-week ultrasound-informed hybrid rehabilitation protocol for rheumatoid arthritis was found feasible and safe in 60 patients, showing greater pain reduction (ΔVAS: -2.88 cm vs. -0.60 cm; p < 0.001) than a control group, though effect sizes may be overestimated and specific ultrasound attribution was limited.
items.curatedReason: 这项概念验证研究提示，超声引导下的类风湿关节炎康复方案是安全且可行的。不过，目前的疼痛改善效应可能被高估了，且超声引导的实际增益还需要更严谨的RCT来验证。
items.titleZh: 超声引导的混合关节保护康复策略对类风湿关节炎患者的可行性、安全性和初步效果：一项前瞻性非随机概念验证研究
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入60例类风湿关节炎患者的12周超声引导混合康复方案，显示出可行性和安全性，且疼痛缓解优于对照组（ΔVAS：-2.88 cm vs. -0.60 cm; p < 0.001），但研究者指出效应量可能被高估，且超声引导的具体作用难以归因。
items.curatedReasonEn: This proof-of-concept study suggests that ultrasound-informed rehabilitation for rheumatoid arthritis is safe and feasible. However, the reported pain improvement may be overestimated, and the actual benefit of ultrasound guidance requires more rigorous RCTs.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本、单中心、非随机研究，且未预设可行性标准，可能导致效应量高估和非特异性接触效应。
items.limitationEn: This was a small, single-center, non-randomized study without prespecified feasibility criteria, potentially leading to overestimated effect sizes and non-specific contact effects.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Walking Capacity and Daily Movement Behaviours After Ischemic Stroke: A Potential Capacity-Performance Gap.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of ambulatory ischemic stroke patients found a capacity-performance gap: participants accumulated ~12 hours/day of sedentary time despite walking speeds approaching community ambulation, with gait speed being the only walking capacity measure associated with daily movement behaviors.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，卒中患者的步行能力与日常活动之间存在“能力-表现差距”，即使步行速度接近社区行走标准，仍可能长时间久坐。它提示你在评估时需要同时关注步态能力和实际的日常活动模式，并针对久坐行为进行干预。
items.titleZh: 缺血性卒中后的步行能力和日常活动行为：潜在的能力-表现差距
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入可步行的缺血性卒中患者的横断面研究发现，即使患者步行速度接近社区行走标准，每天仍有约12小时的久坐时间，存在能力-表现差距；步态速度是唯一与日常活动行为相关的步行能力指标。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals a "capacity-performance gap" in stroke patients, where walking capacity may not translate to daily activity, with prolonged sedentary time despite near-community walking speeds. It suggests the need to assess both gait capacity and actual daily movement patterns, and to intervene on sedentary behavior.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且样本量较小，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, unable to establish causality, and its small sample size may limit generalizability.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Feasibility and Preliminary Effects of Oropharyngeal Alignment Exercise on Swallowing Function in Neurological Disorders with Restricted Mouth Opening: A Pilot Study.
items.summary: A pilot study with 9 participants (7 stroke, 1 Parkinson's) found oropharyngeal alignment exercise feasible and well-tolerated for neurological dysphagia and restricted mouth opening, showing preliminary improvements in maximum mouth opening (6-13 mm), MASA, GUSS, and PAS scores.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究为口咽对齐运动治疗神经系统疾病导致的吞咽困难提供了可行性证据。在等待更大型随机对照试验的同时，你可以考虑将其作为常规康复的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 口咽对齐运动对限制性张口神经系统疾病吞咽功能的可行性和初步效果：一项预试验
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入9名神经系统疾病患者（7名卒中，1名帕金森病）的预试验显示，口咽对齐运动治疗吞咽困难和限制性张口是可行且耐受良好的，并在最大张口度（增加6-13毫米）、MASA、GUSS和PAS评分上观察到初步改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study provides feasibility evidence for oropharyngeal alignment exercise in treating dysphagia caused by neurological disorders. While awaiting larger RCTs, you may consider it as an adjunct to routine rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本单臂初步研究，缺乏对照组，无法确证治疗效果，且诊断人群异质性较高。
items.limitationEn: This was a small, single-arm pilot study lacking a control group, precluding definitive conclusions on treatment efficacy, and with high diagnostic heterogeneity.

items.title: Neurorehabilitation as an Opportunity for Structured Post-Stroke Lipid Management: A Narrative Review.
items.summary: This narrative review suggests neurorehabilitation settings may facilitate optimized lipid management post-ischemic stroke by integrating medication titration, adherence monitoring, and risk stratification, despite a lack of direct rehabilitation-based randomized trials.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后血脂管理对二级预防至关重要。这篇综述提醒我们，康复住院期间是整合药物优化、依从性监测和风险分层的宝贵机会，有助于弥合急性期与长期管理之间的差距。
items.titleZh: 神经康复：卒中后结构化血脂管理的机会：一篇叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述指出，尽管缺乏直接的康复随机试验，但神经康复环境可以通过整合药物调整、依从性监测和风险分层，促进缺血性卒中后的血脂优化管理。
items.curatedReasonEn: Post-stroke lipid management is critical for secondary prevention. This review highlights that neurorehabilitation hospitalization offers a valuable opportunity to integrate medication optimization, adherence monitoring, and risk stratification, helping to bridge the gap between acute and long-term management.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且缺乏直接康复干预的RCT证据来支持其整合策略。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may be subject to selection bias and lacks direct rehabilitation-based RCT evidence to support its integrated strategies.

items.title: Beyond Reconstruction: Return to Olympic Medal Performance Following Morphology-Informed and Criterion-Based Nonoperative Management of a Femoral-Sided Sherman Type II ACL Injury - A Case Report.
items.summary: An elite field hockey player with a femoral-sided Sherman type II ACL injury successfully returned to Olympic medal performance (silver, 200 days post-injury) via morphology-informed nonoperative management and criterion-based rehabilitation, challenging the necessity of reconstruction for select ACL phenotypes.
items.curatedReason: 这例精英运动员ACL损伤非手术康复并重返奥运赛场的报告，挑战了传统上认为高水平运动员必须手术重建的观念。它提示我们，对于特定损伤类型（股骨侧Sherman II型）和选择的患者，以形态学信息和客观标准指导的非手术康复可能是可行的路径。
items.titleZh: 超越重建：股骨侧Sherman II型ACL损伤经形态学指导和基于标准的非手术管理后重返奥运奖牌表现——一例病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一名精英曲棍球运动员在股骨侧Sherman II型ACL损伤后，通过形态学指导的非手术管理和基于标准的康复，成功重返奥运赛场并获得银牌（伤后200天），挑战了部分ACL损伤类型必须进行重建的传统观念。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report of an elite athlete returning to Olympic performance after nonoperative ACL management challenges the traditional view that high-level athletes invariably require surgical reconstruction. It suggests that for specific injury types (femoral-sided Sherman Type II) and selected patients, morphology-informed, criterion-based nonoperative rehabilitation may be a viable pathway.
items.limitation: 这是一篇单例报告，证据等级低，结果不具普遍性，不能直接推及所有ACL损伤或精英运动员。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report with a low level of evidence, and its findings are not generalizable to all ACL injuries or elite athletes.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Validation of Video-based Motion Capture for Lower Body and Trunk Kinematics with Marker Augmentation
items.summary: A study validated video-based motion capture with marker augmentation for lower body and trunk kinematics, suggesting its potential as a low-cost, non-invasive tool for movement analysis.
items.curatedReason: 视频捕捉技术结合标记物增强，在下肢和躯干运动学评估中显示出准确性，这提示我们，低成本、非侵入性的运动分析工具可能很快就能进入临床。在考虑购置昂贵设备前，不妨关注这类技术的成熟度。
items.titleZh: 带标记增强的视频运动捕捉技术在下肢和躯干运动学中的验证
items.summaryZh: 一项研究验证了带标记增强的视频运动捕捉技术在下肢和躯干运动学分析中的准确性，提示了其作为低成本、非侵入性运动分析工具的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Video-based motion capture with marker augmentation shows promise for accurate lower body and trunk kinematics. This suggests low-cost, non-invasive movement analysis tools might soon be viable for clinical use. Before investing in expensive equipment, keep an eye on how these technologies mature.
items.limitation: 该研究的局限性在于可能仅在特定实验室条件下进行验证，其在真实临床环境中的普适性和操作便捷性仍需进一步评估。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of this study is that validation may have been conducted only under specific laboratory conditions, and its generalizability and operational convenience in real clinical settings still require further evaluation.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: Healthcare professionals' perceptions and experiences of promoting physical activity in persons with multiple sclerosis: a systematic review of qualitative evidence.
items.summary: A systematic review of eight qualitative studies identified healthcare professional-based, organizational, social, and patient-related factors influencing physical activity promotion in persons with multiple sclerosis. Findings suggest improving promotion requires MS-specific education for professionals, practical resources, and stronger cross-sector coordination.
items.curatedReason: 这篇系统综述揭示了医疗专业人员在促进多发性硬化症患者身体活动方面的障碍和促进因素。它强调了需要针对MS的教育和培训、患者教育材料以及跨部门协调，以更有效地推广身体活动。
items.titleZh: 医疗专业人员促进多发性硬化症患者身体活动的感知和经验：定性证据的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对8项定性研究的系统综述发现，影响多发性硬化症患者身体活动推广的因素包括医疗专业人员、组织、社会和患者相关因素。研究结果表明，改进推广需要针对专业人员的MS特异性教育、实用资源以及更强的跨部门协调。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights barriers and facilitators for healthcare professionals in promoting physical activity for MS patients. It underscores the need for MS-specific education and training, patient education materials, and cross-sector coordination to improve physical activity promotion.
items.limitation: 本综述仅纳入定性研究，无法提供量化干预效果的证据。
items.limitationEn: This review only included qualitative studies, limiting its ability to quantify intervention effects.

items.title: Adherence System Usability Patient Experience and Psychosocial Impact in Robot Assisted Gait Neurorehabilitation A Cross Sectional Study.
items.summary: This observational study of 250 adults in robot-assisted gait neurorehabilitation found that greater attendance, system usability, and rehabilitation experience were associated with favorable psychosocial impact (r s = 0.41 to 0.53, all p < 0.001). This association remained significant after adjusting for diagnosis, age, sex, and disease duration.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调了在机器人辅助步态神经康复中，患者的依从性、系统可用性和康复体验对社会心理影响至关重要。你应关注这些因素，以优化患者康复效果和满意度。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助步态神经康复中依从系统可用性、患者体验与社会心理影响：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项对250名接受机器人辅助步态神经康复的成年人进行的观察性研究发现，更高的出勤率、系统可用性和康复体验与积极的社会心理影响相关（r s = 0.41至0.53，均 p < 0.001）。在调整了诊断、年龄、性别和疾病持续时间后，这种关联仍然显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights that patient adherence, system usability, and rehabilitation experience are crucial for psychosocial impact in robot-assisted gait neurorehabilitation. You should focus on these factors to optimize patient outcomes and satisfaction.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心观察性研究，存在诊断异质性，同时进行问卷评估，且与出勤率存在时间错配，限制了因果推断。
items.limitationEn: This single-center observational study has diagnostic heterogeneity, simultaneous questionnaire assessment, and a temporal mismatch with attendance, limiting causal inference.

items.title: Gamified Versus Traditional Balance Training: Effects on Balance and Motivation in Collegiate Student-Athletes.
items.summary: In this quasi-experimental controlled trial, 30 collegiate athletes (19.8 ± 0.9 years) were pseudo-randomized to gamified (Wii Fit, n=9), traditional (wobble board, n=11) balance training, or control (n=10). Both training groups showed significant improvements in mSEBT anterior reach (+6.5 cm) and composite scores (+21.6 cm for gamified, +18.5 cm for traditional) compared to control (p < 0.01). Gamified training yielded higher IMI interest/enjoyment scores (5.0 ± 1.2 vs. 3.2 ± 1.3; p < 0.01, d = 1.50).
items.curatedReason: 该 RCT 证实，游戏化平衡训练在改善大学运动员动态平衡方面与传统训练同样有效，且能显著提升训练乐趣。这意味着你可以将游戏化平台纳入康复和损伤预防计划，以提高依从性和参与度。
items.titleZh: 游戏化与传统平衡训练：对大学学生运动员平衡能力和动机的影响
items.summaryZh: 在这项准实验性对照试验中，30名大学运动员（19.8 ± 0.9岁）被假随机分配至游戏化（Wii Fit，n=9）、传统（摇摆板，n=11）平衡训练组或对照组（n=10）。与对照组相比，两个训练组在mSEBT前向触及（+6.5厘米）和综合评分（游戏化组+21.6厘米，传统组+18.5厘米）方面均有显著改善（p < 0.01）。游戏化训练组的内在动机量表（IMI）兴趣/享受得分更高（5.0 ± 1.2 vs. 3.2 ± 1.3；p < 0.01，d = 1.50）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms that gamified balance training is as effective as traditional training in improving dynamic balance in collegiate athletes, while significantly boosting enjoyment. This means you can incorporate gamified platforms into rehabilitation and injury prevention programs to enhance adherence and engagement.
items.limitation: 本研究为准实验性对照试验，并非随机对照，且样本量相对较小（30名运动员），可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This quasi-experimental controlled trial, not an RCT, has a relatively small sample size (30 athletes) and may be subject to selection bias.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Ultrasound-Guided Percutaneous Tendon Dry Needling for Recalcitrant Distal Biceps Tendinopathy: A Case Series.
items.summary: This case series describes two subjects with chronic distal biceps tendinopathy treated with ultrasound-guided percutaneous tendon dry needling and a graded loading program. Both subjects showed clinically important improvements in pain and function at 5 weeks and 6 months, with observable tendon healing.
items.curatedReason: 本案例系列提示超声引导下的干针配合负重训练可能有助于慢性远端肱二头肌肌腱病。但只有两个病例，还远不足以改变你的临床实践。
items.titleZh: 超声引导经皮肌腱干针治疗难治性远端肱二头肌肌腱病：病例系列报告
items.summaryZh: 本病例系列报告描述了两名慢性远端肱二头肌肌腱病患者，经超声引导经皮肌腱干针联合分级负重计划治疗。两名患者在5周和6个月时疼痛和功能均有临床显著改善，并观察到肌腱愈合特征。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case series suggests ultrasound-guided dry needling combined with a loading program may aid chronic distal biceps tendinopathy. However, with only two cases, it's far from practice-changing.
items.limitation: 本研究为病例系列，样本量仅2例，证据等级低，无法推断普遍有效性。
items.limitationEn: This case series has a sample size of only two, providing low-level evidence with limited generalizability.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Effects of Medium-frequency Electrical Stimulation Combined with Near-Infrared Light on Quadriceps Function and Independent Walking in Patients with Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summary: A two-phase study found individuals with SCI had less quadriceps electromyographic activation and impaired deep femoral artery hemodynamics compared to healthy controls. In Phase II, 18 SCI participants (n=9/group) receiving medium-frequency electrical stimulation plus near-infrared light with conventional rehabilitation showed within-group improvements across all outcomes, with significant inter-group differences in right peak systolic velocity and walking ability.
items.curatedReason: 对于脊髓损伤患者，中频电刺激联合近红外光可能有助于改善股四头肌激活和步行能力。但请注意，这是一项小样本的观察研究，初步结果提示了联合治疗的潜力，但尚不足以改变当前的临床实践。
items.titleZh: 中频电刺激联合近红外光对脊髓损伤患者股四头肌功能及独立行走能力的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项两阶段研究发现，脊髓损伤患者与健康对照组相比，股四头肌肌电活动较少，深股动脉血流动力学受损。在第二阶段，18名脊髓损伤患者（每组9人）接受中频电刺激联合近红外光和常规康复治疗，所有评估指标均有组内改善，右侧收缩峰值速度和步行能力有显著组间差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with SCI, combining medium-frequency electrical stimulation and near-infrared light may help improve quadriceps activation and walking ability. However, this was a small observational study; while preliminary results suggest potential for this combined therapy, it's not yet strong enough to alter current clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为非随机对照预-后干预研究，样本量小（18例），且未包含其他下肢肌肉和血管区域的评估，结果尚需更大规模随机研究证实。
items.limitationEn: This non-randomized, controlled pre-post-intervention study has a small sample size (18 cases) and did not assess other lower-limb muscles or vascular territories, requiring larger randomized studies for confirmation.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Development of a Single-Camera Markerless Motion Capture System for Assessing Upper Limb Function Post-Stroke (FULMA).
items.summary: This prospective observational study developed and evaluated FULMA, a single-camera markerless motion capture system for post-stroke upper limb function. In 39 stroke participants, machine learning models achieved a mean accuracy of 83.3% (weighted kappa 0.67-0.88) in predicting task performance scores compared to occupational therapist ratings, showing preliminary agreement.
items.curatedReason: FULMA 系统提供了一种评估卒中后上肢功能的无标记运动捕捉工具，其自动化评分与治疗师评估初步一致。这提示了在临床实践中使用这类客观测量的潜力，能提高评估的一致性和敏感性。
items.titleZh: 开发用于评估卒中后上肢功能的单摄像头无标记运动捕捉系统 (FULMA)
items.summaryZh: 这项前瞻性观察研究开发并评估了FULMA，一个用于卒中后上肢功能的单摄像头无标记运动捕捉系统。在39名卒中参与者中，机器学习模型在预测任务表现评分方面与职业治疗师评分的平均准确度达到83.3%（加权Kappa 0.67-0.88），显示出初步的一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The FULMA system offers a markerless motion capture tool for assessing upper limb function post-stroke, showing preliminary agreement between automated scores and therapist ratings. This highlights the potential of objective measures in clinical practice to improve assessment consistency and sensitivity.
items.limitation: 本研究为早期开发阶段的观察性研究，在受控环境下进行，需要外部验证和更全面的测量特性评估才能用于临床。
items.limitationEn: This is an early-stage observational development study conducted in a controlled setting, requiring external validation and comprehensive measurement property evaluation before clinical use.

items.title: Conservative and Post-Operative Rehabilitation Protocols for Hip Dysplasia in Adolescents to Adulthood: A Literature Review.
items.summary: This literature review of 12 sources examined conservative and post-operative rehabilitation protocols for hip dysplasia in adolescents and adults (13-50 years). It found that physiotherapy, especially multimodal, criterion-based approaches incorporating progressive strengthening and neuromuscular retraining, is a central component.
items.curatedReason: 这篇文献综述确认了物理治疗在青少年和成人髋关节发育不良保守及术后康复中的核心地位。尽管证据质量不高，但它强调了多模式、基于标准的渐进性强化和神经肌肉再训练方案的重要性。
items.titleZh: 青少年至成年髋关节发育不良的保守与术后康复方案：文献综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇文献综述审查了12个来源，探讨了青少年和成人（13-50岁）髋关节发育不良的保守和术后康复方案。研究发现，物理治疗，特别是多模式、基于标准的渐进性强化和神经肌肉再训练方法，是核心组成部分。
items.curatedReasonEn: This literature review confirms the central role of physical therapy in both conservative and post-operative rehabilitation for adolescent and adult hip dysplasia. Despite limitations in evidence quality, it highlights the importance of multimodal, criterion-based progressive strengthening and neuromuscular retraining programs.
items.limitation: 本综述的证据基础受限于方法学异质性、小样本量和对专家共识的依赖，缺乏高质量的比较试验。
items.limitationEn: The evidence base of this review is limited by methodological heterogeneity, small sample sizes, and reliance on expert consensus, with no high-quality comparative trials identified.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Can traditional Chinese exercises help people with musculoskeletal disorders? - BJSM blog - social media's leading SEM voice
items.summary: An umbrella review of 92 meta-analyses of RCTs found high-certainty evidence that traditional Chinese exercises improved physical function and mental health in knee osteoarthritis, mental health in neck pain, and sleep quality in fibromyalgia, with Tai Chi showing the most consistent benefits.
items.curatedReason: 这项伞形综述有力支持了将传统中医运动（如太极、八段锦）纳入肌肉骨骼疾病常规治疗的价值，尤其对膝骨关节炎、颈痛和纤维肌痛的身体功能、心理健康及睡眠质量有确凿证据。这为你向患者推荐低冲击运动方案提供了高级别循证支持。
items.titleZh: 传统中医运动能否帮助肌肉骨骼疾病患者？
items.summaryZh: 一项对92项RCTs荟萃分析的伞形综述发现，有高度确定性证据表明，传统中医运动可改善膝骨关节炎患者的身体功能和心理健康、颈痛患者的心理健康以及纤维肌痛患者的睡眠质量，其中太极拳效果最一致。
items.curatedReasonEn: This umbrella review strongly supports the value of incorporating traditional Chinese exercises (e.g., Tai Chi, Baduanjin) into routine care for musculoskeletal disorders, with high-certainty evidence for physical function, mental health, and sleep quality in knee osteoarthritis, neck pain, and fibromyalgia. This provides high-level evidence for recommending low-impact exercise options to patients.
items.limitation: 伞形综述的局限性在于其纳入的原始研究和系统综述可能存在异质性，且部分结局的证据确定性仍为中等。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of an umbrella review lies in the potential heterogeneity of its included primary studies and systematic reviews, and the certainty of evidence for some outcomes remains moderate.

items.title: CMS Posts Bidder Licensure Guide for Round 2028 of the DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Program & Updates to HCPCS Level II Code Classifications for Certain Leg and Arm Braces | DCBPS Durable Medical Equipment, Prosthetics, Orthotics and Supplies (DMEPOS) Competitive Bidding Program
items.summary: CMS has posted the Round 2028 Bidder Licensure Guide for the DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Program and updated HCPCS Level II code classifications for certain leg and arm braces, effective December 1, 2026, reclassifying L1833, L1851, L1852, and L3761 from off-the-shelf to requiring professional fitting.
items.curatedReason: CMS发布了2028年DMEPOS竞标项目（CBP）的投标者执照指南，并更新了部分腿臂矫形器的HCPCS Level II编码分类，明确这些矫形器不再符合“现成”定义，需要由专业人员适配。这直接影响DMEPOS供应商的投标策略和PT/OT执业者选择和报销相关矫形器的实践。
items.titleZh: CMS发布2028年DMEPOS竞标项目投标者执照指南并更新部分腿臂矫形器HCPCS Level II编码分类
items.summaryZh: CMS发布了2028年DMEPOS竞标项目的投标者执照指南，并更新了部分腿臂矫形器的HCPCS Level II编码分类，自2026年12月1日起，将L1833、L1851、L1852和L3761从“现成”重新分类为需专业人员适配。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has released the Round 2028 Bidder Licensure Guide for the DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Program (CBP) and updated HCPCS Level II code classifications for certain leg and arm braces, clarifying that these braces no longer meet the “off-the-shelf” definition and require fitting by a qualified professional. This directly impacts DMEPOS suppliers' bidding strategies and the practice of PT/OT professionals in selecting and billing for these braces.

items.title: Comparison of Radiofrequency Microtenotomy vs. Heavy-Slow Resistance for Refractory Plantar Fasciopathy: A Randomised Controlled Trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=72) found no significant difference in FHSQ-DK pain domain mean change from baseline to 6 months between radiofrequency microtenotomy and heavy-slow resistance training for refractory plantar fasciopathy (mean difference −4.9, 95% CI −13.8; 4.0).
items.curatedReason: 对于顽固性足底筋膜病，这项RCT明确指出射频微切开术并不优于重慢速抗阻训练。这意味着对这类患者，运动疗法应作为首选干预，避免不必要的微创手术。
items.titleZh: 射频微切开术与重慢速抗阻训练治疗顽固性足底筋膜病的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=72）显示，对于顽固性足底筋膜病，射频微切开术与重慢速抗阻训练在6个月时FHSQ-DK疼痛域的平均变化无显著差异（平均差−4.9，95% CI −13.8; 4.0）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For refractory plantar fasciopathy, this RCT clearly indicates that radiofrequency microtenotomy is not superior to heavy-slow resistance training. This suggests that exercise therapy should be the preferred intervention for these patients, avoiding unnecessary minimally invasive surgery.
items.limitation: 该研究的随访时间为6个月，未能评估长期疗效；且部分患者退出可能影响了最终分析的精确性。
items.limitationEn: The study's follow-up period was 6 months, not allowing for long-term efficacy assessment, and patient dropouts may have affected the precision of the final analysis.

items.title: Radiographic quantification of active self-correction during physiotherapeutic scoliosis-specific exercises and its potential prognostic value in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
items.summary: A prospective study (n=not specified) found that active self-correction during physiotherapeutic scoliosis-specific exercises (PSSE) resulted in 27.32% Cobb angle correction (from 37.57° to 28.82°) and was the only variable significantly associated with 6-month post-treatment Cobb angle change.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性研究首次放射学量化了特发性脊柱侧凸患者在PSSE训练中的主动自我矫正（ASC）程度，并发现其与6个月后的Cobb角变化相关。这提示在临床中评估患者的自我矫正能力，可能有助于预测治疗效果。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗性脊柱侧凸特异性运动中主动自我矫正的影像学量化及其在青少年特发性脊柱侧凸中的潜在预后价值
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性研究（n=未注明）发现，物理治疗性脊柱侧凸特异性运动（PSSE）中的主动自我矫正可使Cobb角矫正27.32%（从37.57°至28.82°），且是唯一与6个月治疗后Cobb角变化显著相关的变量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective study for the first time radiographically quantified active self-correction (ASC) during PSSE in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis and found it correlated with Cobb angle change at 6 months. This suggests that assessing patients' self-correction ability in practice may help predict treatment outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究的样本量相对较小，且随访期为6个月，尚不能完全评估长期预后价值。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size is relatively small, and the 6-month follow-up period is insufficient to fully assess long-term prognostic value.

items.title: Interactive Gardening Intervention for Preschoolers With Developmental Delays: A Family-Centered Feasibility Study.
items.summary: An interactive, family-centered gardening intervention improved social functioning in preschool children with developmental delays (mean change, 3.34 ± 9.47; p = .007) compared to controls, with caregivers reporting high satisfaction, according to a pilot study (n=60 dyads).
items.curatedReason: 对于发育迟缓儿童，家庭园艺干预或许能改善他们的社交功能。尽管只是一个小规模观察研究（60个家庭），且效果幅度偏小（平均改善3.34），但对这类患者的社交支持而言，是一个有意思且值得探索的非传统补充方式。
items.titleZh: 发育迟缓学龄前儿童互动园艺干预：一项以家庭为中心的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项试点研究（60对亲子）显示，与对照组相比，互动式家庭园艺干预改善了发育迟缓学龄前儿童的社交功能（平均变化3.34 ± 9.47；p = .007），家长满意度高。
items.curatedReasonEn: For children with developmental delays, family-centered gardening might improve social functioning. While a small observational study (60 dyads) with a modest effect (mean change 3.34), it's a noteworthy, non-traditional complementary approach worth exploring for social support in this population.
items.limitation: 这是一项非随机对照的试点研究，样本量小，且部分结果未达到统计学意义。
items.limitationEn: This was a non-randomized controlled pilot study with a small sample size, and some results did not reach statistical significance.

items.title: The effect of multi-joint lower-limb training on lower-limb function after total knee arthroplasty: a randomised controlled clinical trial
items.summary: Integrating hip-ankle training into conventional rehabilitation after TKA modestly improved early postoperative LEFS at 4 weeks (+1.55 points, 95% CI 0.02 to 3.07, P = 0.047) in 128 patients, but this advantage diminished by week 12.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，在全膝关节置换术后常规康复中加入髋踝关节训练，在早期（术后4周）对LEFS评分有小幅改善，但临床意义不明显，且优势不持久。在改变常规实践前，需要更强的证据和更长的随访。
items.titleZh: 多关节下肢训练对全膝关节置换术后下肢功能的影响：一项随机对照临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对128名全膝关节置换术后患者的随机对照试验发现，在常规康复中加入髋踝关节训练，可在术后4周适度改善下肢功能量表（LEFS）评分（+1.55分，95% CI 0.02-3.07，P = 0.047），但此优势在12周时减弱。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that adding hip-ankle training to conventional rehabilitation after TKA modestly improves early postoperative LEFS scores at 4 weeks, but the clinical significance is limited and the benefit is not sustained. Stronger evidence and longer follow-up are needed before altering routine practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心研究，随访时间相对较短（12周），且主要结局的临床重要性阈值未明确达到。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center study with a relatively short follow-up (12 weeks), and the clinical importance threshold for the primary outcome was not clearly met.

items.title: GLIM-defined malnutrition and frailty in older outpatients with diabetes
items.summary: Among 391 older outpatients with diabetes, GLIM-defined malnutrition was prevalent in 33% and independently associated with frailty (OR 2.405, 95% CI 1.275–4.537, p = 0.007), according to a retrospective study.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究揭示，在患有糖尿病的老年门诊患者中，GLIM标准定义的营养不良非常普遍（33%），且与衰弱独立相关。这提示你在对老年糖尿病患者进行综合老年评估时，应高度关注营养不良和衰弱的筛查与管理，以支持更个体化的临床干预。
items.titleZh: GLIM定义的营养不良与糖尿病老年门诊患者的衰弱
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性研究显示，在391名糖尿病老年门诊患者中，33%存在GLIM定义的营养不良，且营养不良与衰弱独立相关（OR 2.405, 95% CI 1.275–4.537, p = 0.007）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study reveals that GLIM-defined malnutrition is highly prevalent (33%) and independently associated with frailty in older outpatients with diabetes. This suggests that when conducting comprehensive geriatric assessments for older diabetic patients, you should prioritize screening and managing malnutrition and frailty to support more individualized clinical interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察研究，无法建立因果关系，且结果可能受到未测量混杂因素的影响。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective observational study, which cannot establish causality, and results may be influenced by unmeasured confounding factors.

items.title: Physical and psychosocial outcomes in children with limb loss 2-years after the 2023 Kahramanmaras-Türkiye earthquakes
items.summary: A retrospective analysis (n=56) of children with earthquake-related limb loss 2.3 years post-amputation showed favorable physical, social, and school-related quality of life (median PedsQL 72.3/100.0), but lower emotional functioning (60.0/100.0). Unilateral lower limb loss was associated with superior adjustment and prosthetic satisfaction.
items.curatedReason: 大地震两年后，儿童截肢者的肢体功能、社会功能和学校相关生活质量表现良好，但情感健康仍受影响，提示康复服务应整合长期心理健康支持。
items.titleZh: 2023 年卡赫拉曼马拉什-土耳其地震两年后肢体缺失儿童的身体和心理社会结局
items.summaryZh: 一项对 56 名地震相关肢体缺失儿童的回顾性分析显示，截肢 2.3 年后，其身体、社会和学校相关生活质量良好（PedsQL 中位数 72.3/100.0），但情感功能较低（60.0/100.0）。单侧下肢缺失的儿童表现出更好的适应性和假肢满意度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Two years post-earthquake, children with limb loss showed favorable physical, social, and school-related quality of life, but emotional well-being remained affected. This highlights the need for integrated long-term mental health support within rehabilitation services.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性分析，样本来自单一康复中心，可能存在选择偏倚和数据完整性限制。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective analysis with samples from a single rehabilitation center, which may introduce selection bias and data completeness limitations.

items.title: Power of Functional Mobility Tests in Predicting Fall Risk Among Older Adults.
items.summary: A prospective observational study found that the Timed Up and Go Test (TUG, AUC=0.777) and Four Square Step Test (FSST, AUC=0.771) had the highest discrimination for predicting falls in older adults, though no single test was sufficiently strong alone. Combining tests with fall history (AUC 0.89-0.97) improved model fit.
items.curatedReason: TUG 和 FSST 在预测老年人跌倒风险方面表现出最高的区分度，但单一测试的效能不足以独立预测。将功能测试与跌倒史结合使用可提高预测准确性。
items.titleZh: 功能性活动能力测试在预测老年人跌倒风险中的效用
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察性研究发现，计时起立行走测试（TUG，AUC=0.777）和四方步进测试（FSST，AUC=0.771）在预测老年人跌倒方面具有最高的区分度，但单一测试不足以可靠预测。将功能测试与跌倒史结合（AUC 0.89-0.97）可提高模型拟合度。
items.curatedReasonEn: The TUG and FSST showed the highest discrimination for fall risk in older adults, but individual tests were insufficient for standalone prediction. Combining functional tests with fall history improved predictive accuracy.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心观察性队列研究，样本量相对较小，且功能测试与跌倒史结合的发现需外部验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center observational cohort study with a relatively small sample size, and the findings regarding combining functional tests with fall history require external validation.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Effects of Exercise Type and Duration on Pain, Function, and Quality of Life in Patients With Knee Osteoarthritis: A Systematic Review With Bayesian Network Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review with Bayesian network meta-analysis of 35 trials (n = 3808) found short-term combined aerobic and resistance exercise had the largest effect on pain (SMD = -0.937), function (SMD = -0.590), and quality of life (SMD = 0.663) in patients with knee OA.
items.curatedReason: 这项贝叶斯网络 Meta 分析（35 项试验，3808 名患者）确立了联合有氧和抗阻运动在膝骨关节炎（OA）患者中对疼痛、功能和生活质量的短期（≤12 周）临床意义。这强化了我们应将联合运动处方作为膝 OA 一线干预的证据。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者运动类型与持续时间对疼痛、功能和生活质量的影响：一项贝叶斯网络 Meta 分析系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 35 项试验（3808 名患者）的贝叶斯网络 Meta 分析系统综述发现，在膝骨关节炎患者中，短期联合有氧和抗阻运动对疼痛（SMD = -0.937）、功能（SMD = -0.590）和生活质量（SMD = 0.663）具有最大效应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Bayesian network meta-analysis (35 trials, 3808 patients) establishes the short-term (≤12 weeks) clinical meaningfulness of combined aerobic and resistance exercise for pain, function, and quality of life (QoL) in knee osteoarthritis (OA) patients. This strengthens the evidence for prioritizing combined exercise prescription as a first-line intervention for knee OA.
items.limitation: 短期效应的证据确定性较低（low certainty），长期效应的证据有限且确定性更低（very low certainty），提示还需更多高质量研究。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence for short-term effects was low, and long-term effects were limited and of very low certainty, indicating a need for more high-quality research.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Effectiveness of a Structured Post-Platelet Rich Plasma Rehabilitation Approach on Pain and Function in Subacromial Pain Syndrome: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A 21-day structured post-PRP rehabilitation approach, added to standard physiotherapy, significantly improved pain (VAS: 9.00 ± 0.67 to 2.92 ± 1.14 vs. 9.11 ± 0.64 to 7.96 ± 0.75, p < 0.001) and function in 27 subacromial pain syndrome participants compared to standard physiotherapy alone.
items.curatedReason: 结构化康复方案与 PRP 联合使用对肩峰下疼痛综合征有短期益处，尤其是在疼痛缓解、肌力、活动度和功能方面。将其视为标准疗法之外的潜在补充，但要注意尚无长期随访数据。
items.titleZh: 结构化 PRP 术后康复方案对肩峰下疼痛综合征疼痛与功能的影响：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 21 天的随机对照试验显示，在标准物理治疗基础上增加结构化 PRP 术后康复方案，在肩峰下疼痛综合征患者中显著改善疼痛（VAS 从 9.00 ± 0.67 降至 2.92 ± 1.14，对照组从 9.11 ± 0.64 降至 7.96 ± 0.75；p < 0.001）和功能，共 27 名受试者参与。
items.curatedReasonEn: A structured rehabilitation approach combined with PRP shows short-term benefits for subacromial pain syndrome, particularly in pain relief, muscle strength, range of motion, and function. Consider it a potential adjunct to standard therapy, but note the lack of long-term follow-up data.
items.limitation: 本研究的随访期仅为 21 天，无法评估长期效果和改善的可持续性。
items.limitationEn: The study's follow-up period was only 21 days, preventing assessment of long-term effects and sustainability of improvements.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Treatment Planning in Physical and Rehabilitation Medicine: A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review found 9 studies showing Large Language Models (LLMs) have promising capabilities in supporting rehabilitation treatment planning, with concordance rates up to 98.75% with expert opinion, though "hallucinations" were reported.
items.curatedReason: 大型语言模型（LLM）在康复治疗计划中展现出前景，能与专家意见保持高度一致，尤其在肌骨和心血管康复领域。你可以关注其在辅助个性化方案制定上的潜力，但需警惕“幻觉”现象，人工监督仍不可或缺。
items.titleZh: 人工智能在物理和康复医学治疗计划中的作用：一项系统综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述纳入 9 项研究发现，大型语言模型（LLMs）在康复治疗计划中展现出前景，与专家意见的一致性可达 98.75%，但需注意其潜在的“幻觉”问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise in rehabilitation treatment planning, aligning well with expert opinions, especially in musculoskeletal and cardiovascular rehab. Monitor their potential for assisting personalized plan development, but be aware of "hallucinations"; human supervision remains essential.
items.limitation: 纳入研究数量有限，且 LLM 存在“幻觉”问题，仍需高质量研究验证其在实际康复中的有效性和安全性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies and the issue of LLM "hallucinations" mean that high-quality research is still needed to validate their real-world effectiveness and safety in rehabilitation.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: From Referral to Reality: A Mixed Methods Analysis of Barriers to Pediatric Rehabilitation Service Initiation.
items.summary: A mixed-methods study of 8,533 pediatric rehabilitation referrals found only a 42.7% service initiation rate, with barriers including geographic availability, scheduling, communication, and financial challenges, varying by patient characteristics.
items.curatedReason: 这项混合方法研究揭示了儿童康复服务依从性低（仅 42.7%）背后的复杂障碍，包括地理可及性、排班困难、费用、交通以及专业人员与家庭沟通不畅等。应关注这些因素，以提高服务启动率并减少社会人口学差异。
items.titleZh: 从转诊到现实：儿科康复服务启动障碍的混合方法分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 8,533 份儿科康复转诊的混合方法研究显示，服务启动率仅为 42.7%，障碍包括地域可及性、排班、沟通和财务挑战，并因患者特征而异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This mixed-methods study reveals complex barriers behind low pediatric rehabilitation service initiation rates (only 42.7%), including geographic availability, scheduling difficulties, cost, transportation, and poor communication between professionals and families. Addressing these factors is crucial for improving service initiation and reducing sociodemographic disparities.
items.limitation: 这项研究来自单一的儿科医疗机构，其结果可能存在地域性和系统性局限，不一定能完全推广至其他医疗系统或更广泛的地理区域。
items.limitationEn: This study was conducted within a single pediatric healthcare organization, and its findings may have geographic and systemic limitations, potentially not fully generalizable to other healthcare systems or broader regions.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Learned helplessness is associated with jump-landing biomechanics following anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction.
items.summary: In 33 individuals post-ACLR, greater learned helplessness was moderately associated with greater peak knee abduction in the ACLR limb (r = 0.564, p = 0.001) during jump-landings, accounting for 34.8% of variance.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，ACL 重建术后的“习得性无助”心理状态可能与动态膝关节外翻力学改变有关。除了关注体能恢复，也应将心理和神经行为因素纳入康复和重返运动评估中，可能有助于改善生物力学结果和降低再损伤风险。
items.titleZh: 习得性无助与前交叉韧带重建术后跳跃落地生物力学相关。
items.summaryZh: 对 33 名前交叉韧带重建术后个体研究发现，在跳跃落地时，较高的习得性无助感与重建侧肢体更大的峰值膝关节外展角度中度相关（r = 0.564, p = 0.001），解释了 34.8% 的方差。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that learned helplessness after ACLR may be associated with altered dynamic knee abduction mechanics. Beyond physical recovery, psychological and neurobehavioral factors should be integrated into rehabilitation and return-to-sport assessments to potentially improve biomechanical outcomes and reduce re-injury risk.
items.limitation: 本研究的样本量相对较小（33 人），且仅为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，也无法推断习得性无助随时间变化的趋势。
items.limitationEn: The study has a relatively small sample size (33 participants) and a cross-sectional design, precluding causal inference and the ability to track changes in learned helplessness over time.

items.title: Individualized systems-informed corrective exercise for adults meeting prespecified criteria for upper crossed syndrome: protocol for a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: This is a protocol for an RCT (n=36) to evaluate the added effect of an individualized, systems-informed corrective exercise program for adults with upper crossed syndrome, focusing on postural angles as the primary outcome over 12 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 这是一项针对“上交叉综合征”的随机对照试验方案，旨在验证个体化、分阶段的矫正运动方案的附加效果。该方案尝试标准化入组标准和干预内容，有助于提高研究可重复性。对肩颈姿势问题感兴趣的临床医师可以关注其后续研究结果。
items.titleZh: 针对符合上交叉综合征预设标准的成年人的个体化系统矫正运动：一项随机对照试验方案。
items.summaryZh: 这是一项针对 36 名符合上交叉综合征预设标准的成年人的随机对照试验方案，旨在评估个体化、系统知情矫正运动方案的附加效果，主要结局指标是 12 周后的姿势角度。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is a protocol for an RCT on "upper crossed syndrome," aiming to validate the additive effect of individualized, staged corrective exercise. The protocol standardizes eligibility and interventions, which should improve reproducibility. Clinicians interested in shoulder-neck posture issues may follow its future results.
items.limitation: 这是一项研究方案，尚未有实际结果数据，且其 4 周的随访期无法提供关于复发预防的长期推论。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol without actual results yet, and its 4-week follow-up period will not support long-term inferences about recurrence prevention.

items.title: First-Hand Experience and the Value of Telerehabilitation for Chronic Knee Pain: A Discrete Choice Experiment Nested in a Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A discrete choice experiment nested in an RCT found that patients with prior telerehabilitation experience were willing to pay significantly more (AU$87.49) for telehealth consultations for chronic knee pain compared to those with in-person experience.
items.curatedReason: 有远程康复经验的患者明显更愿意为慢加性膝关节疼痛的远程医疗咨询付费，AU$87.49 的支付意愿差额印证了这点。打算拓展远程医疗服务的同行们请注意，实际使用经验才是提升患者接受度和支付意愿的关键。
items.titleZh: 慢性膝痛远程康复的亲身体验及其价值：一项随机对照试验中的离散选择实验
items.titleEn: First-Hand Experience and the Value of Telerehabilitation for Chronic Knee Pain: A Discrete Choice Experiment Nested in a Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summaryZh: 一项嵌套在随机对照试验中的离散选择实验发现，有远程康复经验的患者更愿意为慢性膝痛的远程医疗咨询支付费用（高出 87.49 澳元）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides evidence that prior experience with telerehabilitation significantly increases willingness to pay for it. This finding is important for providers considering expanding or adopting telehealth services for chronic knee pain, suggesting patient acceptance is linked to actual use.
items.limitation: 离散选择实验依赖假设情景，可能无法完全反映真实世界中的选择。
items.limitationEn: The discrete choice experiment relies on hypothetical scenarios, which may not perfectly reflect real-world choices.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Comparison of robot-assisted gait training and visual feedback balance training on balance and gait outcomes in patients with stroke: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized trial comparing robot-assisted gait training (RoboGait) with visual feedback balance training (ProKin-252) in stroke patients found ProKin-252 led to significantly greater improvements in balance (BBS) and reduced fear of falling, though overall functional gains were similar between groups.
items.curatedReason: 尽管卒中患者的总体功能改善在两组中相似，ProKin-252 视觉反馈平衡训练在平衡能力（BBS）和减少跌倒恐惧方面表现出统计学上的显著优势。这提示我们，在卒中康复中，视觉反馈干预可能在特定恢复领域有微弱但可靠的领先。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助步态训练与视觉反馈平衡训练对卒中患者平衡和步态结局的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.titleEn: Comparison of robot-assisted gait training and visual feedback balance training on balance and gait outcomes in patients with stroke: a randomized controlled trial
items.summaryZh: 一项比较卒中患者机器人辅助步态训练（RoboGait）与视觉反馈平衡训练（ProKin-252）的随机试验显示，ProKin-252 在平衡（BBS）和恐惧跌倒方面有更显著改善，尽管总体功能获益相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: While both robot-assisted gait training and visual feedback balance training improved outcomes, ProKin-252 visual feedback showed a modest but statistically significant advantage in balance (BBS) and reduced fear of falling. This suggests that for patients with stroke, prioritizing visual feedback interventions might offer a slight edge in specific areas of recovery.
items.limitation: 主要结局（BBS）的微小差异以及在更广泛功能结局中缺乏显著差异，限制了观察到的优势的临床意义。
items.limitationEn: The modest difference in the primary outcome (BBS) and the lack of significant differences in broader functional outcomes limit the clinical significance of the observed advantage.

items.title:
XR serious games for phantom limb pain, neurofunctional recovery, and prosthetic adoption: a systematic review
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A systematic review of 24 studies found that XR serious games demonstrated preliminary benefits in reducing phantom limb pain (largest effect sizes with AR-based phantom motor execution systems, d = 0.9–1.3), improving functional mobility, and supporting prosthesis adoption after amputation.
items.curatedReason: XR 严肃游戏，特别是 AR 幻肢运动执行系统（d = 0.9–1.3），有望作为截肢术后幻肢痛管理、功能活动度提升和假肢适应的新辅助手段。虽然这只是初步证据，但其在疼痛干预和假肢使用训练方面的潜力值得我们关注。
items.titleZh: 用于幻肢痛、神经功能恢复和假肢采纳的扩展现实（XR）严肃游戏：一项系统综述
items.titleEn: XR serious games for phantom limb pain, neurofunctional recovery, and prosthetic adoption: a systematic review
items.summaryZh: 一项对 24 项研究的系统综述发现，扩展现实（XR）严肃游戏在减轻幻肢痛（AR 幻肢运动执行系统效应量最大，d=0.9-1.3）、改善截肢后的功能活动能力和支持假肢采纳方面显示出初步益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: XR serious games, especially AR-based phantom motor execution systems (d = 0.9–1.3), show promise as an adjunct for managing phantom limb pain, improving functional mobility, and aiding prosthesis adoption post-amputation. While preliminary, this evidence warrants attention for its potential in pain intervention and prosthetic training.
items.limitation: 神经功能和具身性结局的证据仍处于探索阶段，XR游戏的实际应用和可扩展性仍有待深入研究。
items.limitationEn: The evidence for neurofunctional and embodiment outcomes is still exploratory, and real-world implementation and scalability of XR games remain under-researched.

items.title: Timed Up and Go, gait speed, and grip strength: associations and discriminative performance for falls in community-dwelling older adults - results from the KORA-age study
items.summary: In community-dwelling older adults, the Timed Up and Go (TUG) test remained associated with falls after frailty adjustment, but neither TUG, gait speed, nor grip strength showed clear incremental discrimination beyond age and sex, and combining measures did not improve prediction.
items.curatedReason: 该研究再次确认了 TUG 测试与社区老年人跌倒之间的关联，即使调整了虚弱因素。然而，TUG、步态速度和握力在年龄和性别之外没有显示出明显的额外区分能力，并且组合这些指标也未能提高预测准确性。这表明，TUG 虽是实用指标，但单一使用不足以精准预测跌倒风险。
items.titleZh: timed up and go、步速和握力：与跌倒的关联性及社区居住老年人的鉴别性能 - KORA-age 研究结果
items.titleEn: Timed Up and Go, gait speed, and grip strength: associations and discriminative performance for falls in community-dwelling older adults - results from the KORA-age study
items.summaryZh: 在社区居住的老年人中，调整衰弱后，Timed Up and Go（TUG）测试仍与跌倒相关，但 TUG、步速和握力均未显示出超越年龄和性别的明显增量鉴别能力，组合测量也未能提高预测性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reinforces the association between the Timed Up and Go (TUG) test and falls in older adults, even after adjusting for frailty. However, its limited incremental discriminatory power beyond age and sex suggests that while TUG is a useful marker, it may not be sufficient on its own for precise fall risk prediction.
items.limitation: 所有测试的身体表现测量均未显示出超越年龄和性别的清晰增量区分，且既定的TUG阈值在识别跌倒者方面敏感性有限。
items.limitationEn: None of the tested physical performance measures showed clear incremental discrimination beyond age and sex, and established TUG thresholds had limited sensitivity for identifying fallers.

items.title: The impact of multidisciplinary intervention under the concept of ERAS on the prognosis of frail older patients undergoing gastrectomy: a non-randomized prospective cohort study
items.summary: A non-randomized prospective cohort study found that a multidisciplinary ERAS-based intervention for frail older patients undergoing gastrectomy led to lower postoperative complication rates (P=0.043), shorter hospital stays (7.1 vs. 10.5 days), and improved functional recovery (6-minute walk test) compared to conventional care.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究表明，针对虚弱老年胃切除术患者的多学科 ERAS 干预能显著降低术后并发症率（P=0.043）、缩短住院时间（7.1 对 10.5 天）并改善功能恢复。对这类脆弱人群，整合性、团队协作的围手术期护理是值得推广的策略。
items.titleZh: ERAS理念下多学科干预对进行胃切除术的衰弱老年患者预后的影响：一项非随机前瞻性队列研究
items.titleEn: The impact of multidisciplinary intervention under the concept of ERAS on the prognosis of frail older patients undergoing gastrectomy: a non-randomized prospective cohort study
items.summaryZh: 一项针对接受胃切除术的衰弱老年患者的非随机前瞻性队列研究发现，基于ERAS的多学科干预可降低术后并发症发生率（P=0.043）、缩短住院时间（7.1 vs. 10.5天），并改善功能恢复，优于常规护理。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study suggests that a multidisciplinary ERAS-based intervention can significantly improve outcomes for frail older patients undergoing gastrectomy, including reduced complications and hospital stay. This supports the integration of comprehensive, team-based perioperative care for this vulnerable population.
items.limitation: 本研究采用非随机化设计与历史对照，且30天再入院率差异无统计学意义。
items.limitationEn: The study used a non-randomized design with historical controls, and the 30-day readmission rate difference was not statistically significant.

items.title: Squeezing more out of less: blood-flow restriction training in COPD and other conditions, from the clinic to the home
items.summary: This commentary discusses blood flow restriction (BFR) training as a low-load resistance exercise strategy that achieves strength gains comparable to high-load training, suggesting its utility for patients with COPD and other conditions, enabling exercise from clinic to home.
items.curatedReason: 这篇评论强调，血流限制（BFR）训练作为一种低负荷阻力运动策略，能达到与高负荷训练相当的力量增益。对于 COPD 及其他不耐受高负荷训练的患者，BFR 有望成为一种从诊所到家庭都可实行的有效方案，值得临床同行进一步关注。
items.titleZh: “少即是多”：从诊所到居家，COPD及其他疾病的血流限制训练
items.titleEn: Squeezing more out of less: blood-flow restriction training in COPD and other conditions, from the clinic to the home
items.summaryZh: 本文评述了血流限制（BFR）训练作为一种低负荷阻力训练策略，可实现与高负荷训练相当的力量增益，并提出其在COPD等疾病患者中的应用前景，支持从诊所到居家进行训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights blood flow restriction (BFR) training as a promising low-load resistance training method that can elicit strength gains comparable to high-load training. Its application in populations intolerant to high loads, such as those with COPD, from clinic to home, warrants further clinical attention.

items.title: Effects of Hypoxic Exposure and Training Methods on Wingate Test Performance: A Systematic Review
items.summary: A systematic review of 43 studies found acute hypoxic exposure generally does not decrease Wingate test performance unless severe (FiO2 ~0.104) or repeated; prolonged chronic exposure can reduce performance, but shorter camps do not. Intermittent hypoxic training likely benefits performance when combined with longer exercise durations.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述指出，急性缺氧暴露通常不会降低 Wingate 测试表现，除非缺氧程度严重 (FiO2 ~0.104) 或反复暴露；长期慢性缺氧可能会降低表现，但短期训练营则不会。间歇性低氧训练在结合更长运动持续时间时，很可能有利于提高表现。
items.titleZh: 缺氧暴露和训练方法对 Wingate 测试表现的影响：一项系统综述
items.titleEn: Effects of Hypoxic Exposure and Training Methods on Wingate Test Performance: A Systematic Review
items.summaryZh: 一项对 43 项研究的系统综述发现，急性缺氧暴露通常不会降低 Wingate 测试表现，除非在严重（FiO2 ~0.104）或重复情况下；长期慢性暴露可能降低表现，但短期训练营则不会。间歇性缺氧训练可能在与较长运动时间结合时有益于表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review indicates that acute hypoxic exposure does not significantly impair Wingate test performance unless severe or repeated, and prolonged chronic exposure may reduce anaerobic performance. Intermittent hypoxic training, especially with longer exercise durations, may enhance anaerobic capacity.
items.limitation: 该综述发现，高强度间歇训练可能会提高无氧运动表现，无论是否缺氧，这表明训练方式本身是关键。
items.limitationEn: The review found that high-intensity interval training may improve anaerobic performance regardless of hypoxic exposure, suggesting the modality itself is key.

items.title: Match Exposure and Estimated Travel Before ACL Injury in Professional Women’s Football: An Exploratory Within-Player Case-Crossover Study
items.summary: An exploratory case-crossover study in professional women's football found that injury seasons had slightly greater match exposure (minutes, appearances) and estimated travel distance in the 30 days prior to injury compared to matched control periods, though effect sizes were small and variability was high.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究提出，在职业女子足球中，受伤前 30 天的比赛暴露（上场时间、出场次数）和预估旅行距离可能略有增加。尽管效应量小且变异性大，这些发现可为未来前瞻性研究的 ACL 损伤预防策略提供思路。
items.titleZh: 职业女子足球运动员 ACL 损伤前的比赛暴露与预估行程：一项探索性个体交叉研究
items.titleEn: Match Exposure and Estimated Travel Before ACL Injury in Professional Women’s Football: An Exploratory Within-Player Case-Crossover Study
items.summaryZh: 一项对职业女子足球运动员的探索性个体交叉研究发现，与匹配的对照期相比，ACL 损伤赛季前的比赛暴露（分钟数、出场次数）和 30 天内的预估行程稍多，但效应量小且变异性大。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study suggests that slightly higher match exposure and travel distance may precede ACL injuries in professional women’s football. While effect sizes are small and variability is high, these findings could inform future prospective research on injury prevention strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为探索性研究，效应量小，玩家间变异性大，且未建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The study is exploratory with small effect sizes and substantial between-player variability, and it does not establish causality.

items.title: CMS Extends and Modifies Nationwide Freeze on New Medicare Hospice and Home Health Enrollment for Six Months to Combat Fraud
items.summary: CMS has extended and modified the nationwide freeze on new Medicare hospice and home health enrollment for an additional six months to combat fraud.
items.curatedReason: CMS 将全国范围内针对新的 Medicare 安宁疗护和家庭健康机构注册的冻结延长并修改六个月。如果你在考虑开设新的安宁疗护或家庭健康服务，这表明美国监管环境收紧，短期内机会窗口关闭，需要密切关注后续政策走向。
items.titleZh: CMS 延长并修改全国范围内对新的 Medicare 安宁疗护和家庭健康机构注册的冻结六个月，以打击欺诈行为
items.summaryZh: CMS 已将全国范围内针对新的 Medicare 安宁疗护和家庭健康机构注册的冻结延长并修改六个月，以打击欺诈行为。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has extended and modified the nationwide freeze on new Medicare hospice and home health enrollment for six months. If you are considering opening new hospice or home health services, this indicates a tightening regulatory environment in the U.S. and a closed window of opportunity in the short term. You should closely monitor future policy developments.

items.title: Effects of adjunctive craniosacral therapy to conventional physiotherapy on postural responses and autonomic function in individuals with multiple sclerosis: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: An 8-week RCT (n=30) found that adjunctive craniosacral therapy (CST) to conventional physiotherapy in MS patients led to greater reductions in Adaptation Test (toes-down) and Motor Control Test (back-small) latency measures (p=.034, η2=0.129; p=.006, η2=0.166, respectively), but no significant between-group differences were observed at any assessment point, nor were significant treatment effects on autonomic function detected.
items.curatedReason: 虽然颅骶疗法（CST）结合常规物理治疗可能对多发性硬化症患者的特定姿势反应参数产生影响，但本研究并未证明CST具有优于常规疗法的效果，也未对自主神经功能产生显著治疗作用。临床实践中继续以有明确证据的干预为主。
items.titleZh: 颅骶疗法联合常规物理治疗对多发性硬化症患者姿势反应和自主神经功能的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 8 周的随机对照试验（n=30）显示，多发性硬化症患者在常规物理治疗基础上增加颅骶疗法（CST），在适应性测试（脚尖向下）和运动控制测试（后小）的潜伏期测量中表现出更大的缩短（p=.034, η2=0.129；p=.006, η2=0.166），但未在任何评估时点观察到组间显著差异，自主神经功能也未见显著治疗效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: While craniosacral therapy (CST) combined with conventional physiotherapy may influence specific postural response parameters in MS patients, this study did not demonstrate superiority over conventional therapy or significant treatment effects on autonomic function. Continue to prioritize evidence-based interventions in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（n=30），且为单盲设计，可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=30) and was single-blind, potentially limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Regression-Based Balance Discordance Refines Prediction of Prospective Falls After Subacute Stroke: A Secondary Analysis of the LEAPS Trial
items.summary: A secondary analysis (n=384) of the LEAPS trial found that continuous, regression-based balance discordance, particularly multivariable discordance, predicted prospective recurrent falls after subacute stroke (HR=1.27, 95% CI 1.03-1.58, p=.026), whereas a previously published threshold-based classification did not. Single-variable discordance showed a lower fall hazard (HR = 0.79, 95% CI 0.63-0.99, p = .037).
items.curatedReason: 这次对 LEAPS 试验的二次分析提示，在卒中后跌倒风险评估中，你可能需要放弃基于阈值的分类法。用连续的、多变量回归分析来衡量患者的平衡信心与客观表现之间的不一致，可能更准确地预测复发性跌倒（HR=1.27）。
items.titleZh: 基于回归的平衡不一致性可更精准预测亚急性卒中后前瞻性跌倒：LEAPS 试验的二次分析
items.summaryZh: LEAPS 试验的一项二次分析（n=384）发现，连续的、基于回归的平衡不一致性，尤其是多变量不一致性，能预测亚急性卒中后的前瞻性复发性跌倒（HR=1.27, 95% CI 1.03-1.58, p=.026），而之前发布的基于阈值的分类则未能做到。单变量不一致性显示出较低的跌倒风险（HR = 0.79, 95% CI 0.63-0.99, p = .037）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This secondary analysis of the LEAPS trial suggests you might want to move away from threshold-based classifications for post-stroke fall risk. A continuous, multivariable regression approach to measure discordance between balance confidence and objective performance appears to predict recurrent falls more accurately (HR=1.27).
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察分析，依赖于原有随机对照试验（LEAPS）的数据，可能存在未测量的混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This was a secondary, observational analysis of a randomized controlled trial (LEAPS), which may be subject to unmeasured confounders.

items.title: VRCycle: A Feasibility Randomized Controlled Trial Evaluating a Virtual Reality Cycling Intervention in People With Knee Osteoarthritis.
items.summary: A two-arm feasibility RCT (n=41) found that both VR-enhanced cycling and traditional cycling for 6 weeks were highly feasible and acceptable for people with knee osteoarthritis, showing preliminary improvements in pain, function, and exercise capacity.
items.curatedReason: 对于膝骨关节炎患者，VR 辅助骑行和传统骑行都高度可行且可接受，能在 6 周内初步改善疼痛、功能和运动能力。VR 方案或许能增加患者运动依从性，但此为小型可行性 RCT（n=41），尚不能得出定论，期待大型试验数据。
items.titleZh: VRCycle：一项评估虚拟现实骑行干预对膝骨关节炎患者可行性的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项双臂可行性随机对照试验（n=41）发现，为期 6 周的虚拟现实增强骑行和传统骑行对膝骨关节炎患者均高度可行且可接受，并在疼痛、功能和运动能力方面显示出初步改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Both VR-enhanced cycling and traditional cycling are highly feasible and acceptable for people with knee osteoarthritis, showing preliminary improvements in pain, function, and exercise capacity over 6 weeks. While VR may boost exercise adherence, this was a small feasibility RCT (n=41), so don't draw firm conclusions yet; larger trials are needed.
items.limitation: 这是一项可行性研究，样本量小（n=41），不具备评估疗效的统计功效。
items.limitationEn: This was a feasibility study with a small sample size (n=41) and was not powered to evaluate efficacy.

items.title: Next-generation control strategies for lower-extremity exoskeletons: State-of-the-art, limitations, and future directions.
items.summary: A review of lower-extremity exoskeleton control strategies highlights current limitations in user intent detection, adaptability, and cognitive burden. It explores emerging approaches like brain-computer interfaces and nerve interfaces to enable more natural and autonomous mobility for gait rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述深入剖析了下肢外骨骼控制策略的现状与瓶颈。它为关注神经康复中机器人辅助步态训练的临床医生，系统性地梳理了技术发展方向，尤其对未来外骨骼与用户意图融合的进展有重要参考价值。
items.titleZh: 下肢外骨骼的下一代控制策略：现状、局限性与未来方向
items.summaryZh: 一篇关于下肢外骨骼控制策略的综述强调了用户意图检测、适应性和认知负担方面的现有局限性。该综述探讨了脑机接口和神经接口等新兴方法，以实现步态康复中更自然、更自主的移动能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review deeply analyzes the current state and bottlenecks of lower-extremity exoskeleton control strategies. For clinicians focused on robot-assisted gait training in neurological rehabilitation, it systematically outlines technological development directions, especially regarding future integration of exoskeletons with user intent.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，基于现有文献而非原始数据，可能存在选择偏倚且无法进行定量分析。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, based on existing literature rather than original data, which may introduce selection bias and prevent quantitative analysis.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: User Experience of a Rehab Community-Based, Affordable Robot Exercise System (Rehab CARES) for Gamified Motor and Cognitive Stroke Rehabilitation
items.summary: A longitudinal study (n=6 adults with chronic stroke) on RehabCARES, a gamified robot exercise system for motor and cognitive stroke rehabilitation, reported low pain, light-to-moderate perceived exertion, strong enjoyment, and high usability scores (peaking at 86/100), indicating a positive user experience in a community setting.
items.curatedReason: 这款社区康复机器人系统（RehabCARES）的用户体验积极，证实了机器人辅助训练在卒中后运动和认知康复中的可行性与可接受性。它提示了未来社区康复模式中智能硬件的潜力，能为你的患者提供个性化且有吸引力的训练。
items.titleZh: 基于社区的经济型机器人锻炼系统（Rehab CARES）在游戏化运动和认知卒中康复中的用户体验
items.summaryZh: 一项关于 RehabCARES（一种用于运动和认知卒中康复的游戏化机器人锻炼系统）的纵向研究（n=6 名慢性卒中成人）报告称，该系统在社区环境中提供了积极的用户体验，表现为低疼痛、轻至中度感知劳累、强烈的愉悦感和高可用性评分（最高 86/100）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This community-based rehabilitation robot system (RehabCARES) received positive user experience, confirming the feasibility and acceptability of robot-assisted training for post-stroke motor and cognitive rehabilitation. It indicates the potential of smart hardware in future community rehabilitation models, offering personalized and engaging training for your patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的用户体验研究，样本量小（n=6），且缺乏对照组，无法评估其确切的临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary user experience study with a small sample size (n=6) and lacks a control group, preventing assessment of definitive clinical efficacy.

items.title: Use of Rehabilitation Therapy Services among World Trade Center Health Program Members with Cancer
items.summary: This study aims to examine the utilization of rehabilitation therapy services among World Trade Center Health Program members with cancer certification between 2011 and 2024.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究（2011-2024 年数据）揭示了世贸中心健康计划中癌症患者康复服务的使用模式。它提示了特定高危人群在康复服务可及性和利用上的潜在缺口，值得我们作为政策制定者和康复服务提供者深入评估。
items.titleZh: 世贸中心健康计划癌症患者康复治疗服务利用情况
items.summaryZh: 本研究旨在调查 2011 年至 2024 年间，世贸中心健康计划中患有癌症的成员对康复治疗服务的利用情况。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study (2011-2024 data) illuminates rehabilitation service utilization patterns among cancer patients in the World Trade Center Health Program. It signals potential gaps in accessibility and uptake for this specific high-risk population, warranting deeper evaluation from policymakers and rehabilitation providers like us.
items.limitation: 尚无摘要或全文，无法评估研究设计细节，可能存在因数据来源和人群特异性导致的局限。
items.limitationEn: No abstract or full text is available to assess study design details; limitations may exist due to data source and population specificity.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: A case-series exploring real-world postural behaviour change following physiotherapy for low back pain.
items.summary: A case series (n=5) using wearable sensors found real-world lumbar posture differences between pre- and post-physiotherapy days in three participants with chronic low back pain, with pain often preceded by increased end-range flexion, aligning with clinical assessment in some cases.
items.curatedReason: 这项案例系列研究通过可穿戴传感器展示了现实生活中腰痛患者的姿势行为变化。它提示了可穿戴技术在个体化姿势指导和评估中的潜力，但需要更强的研究设计来归因干预效果。
items.titleZh: 一项探索物理治疗后腰痛患者现实世界姿势行为变化的案例系列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项使用可穿戴传感器进行的案例系列研究（n=5）发现，三名慢性腰痛患者在物理治疗前后，其现实世界腰椎姿势存在差异，且疼痛通常由末端屈曲增加引起，部分情况与临床评估一致。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case series explores real-world postural changes in low back pain patients using wearable sensors. It highlights the potential of wearable tech in personalized postural guidance and assessment, but stronger study designs are needed to attribute intervention effects.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本（n=5）的案例系列研究，缺乏重复基线测量，无法将观察到的变化归因于物理治疗干预。
items.limitationEn: This is a small case series (n=5) lacking repeated baseline measurements, so observed changes cannot be attributed to the physiotherapy intervention.

items.title: Comparative Efficacy of Low-Level Laser Therapy in Patients With Carpal Tunnel Syndrome: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
items.summary: An updated systematic review and meta-analysis of 16 RCTs found low-level laser therapy (LLLT) significantly reduced pain (Hedges' g=-1.524, P <0.001) and improved grip strength (Hedges' g=0.391, P=0.002) in carpal tunnel syndrome. Pulsed mode was superior for analgesia, continuous for grip strength.
items.curatedReason: 对于腕管综合征患者，明确使用 LLLT。本综述证实 LLLT 能显著缓解疼痛（Hedges' g=-1.524）并提升握力（Hedges' g=0.391）。治疗时请注意：脉冲模式更利于镇痛，而连续模式对改善握力效果更佳。
items.titleZh: 低能量激光疗法治疗腕管综合征患者的比较疗效：随机对照试验的最新系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 16 项随机对照试验的最新系统综述和荟萃分析发现，低能量激光疗法 (LLLT) 显著减轻了腕管综合征的疼痛 (Hedges' g=-1.524, P <0.001) 并改善了握力 (Hedges' g=0.391, P=0.002)。脉冲模式在镇痛方面表现更优，连续模式则有利于握力。
items.curatedReasonEn: For your carpal tunnel syndrome patients, definitely incorporate LLLT. This review confirms significant pain reduction (Hedges' g=-1.524) and improved grip strength (Hedges' g=0.391). When applying, remember that pulsed mode is superior for analgesia, while continuous mode is better for improving grip strength.
items.limitation: 不同研究间激光参数、治疗方案和评估方法存在异质性，可能影响结果的综合性。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity in laser parameters, treatment regimens, and assessment methods across studies may affect the generalizability of results.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Physiological responses during high intensity interval training and moderate intensity continuous training in patients attending early cardiac rehabilitation.
items.summary: In 18 cardiac rehabilitation patients, low-volume HIIT elicited greater ventilatory, hemodynamic, and metabolic demands (e.g., higher mean VO₂, %HRR, blood lactate) and higher perceived exertion compared to time-matched MICT, suggesting a greater physiological stimulus.
items.curatedReason: 这项单中心随机交叉试验对比了早期心脏康复中高强度间歇训练（HIIT）与中等强度持续训练（MICT）的生理反应，明确了 HIIT 能提供更大的生理刺激，为你制定个性化心血管康复方案提供了依据。
items.titleZh: 早期心脏康复患者进行高强度间歇训练和中等强度持续训练时的生理反应
items.summaryZh: 在 18 名早期心脏康复患者中，低容量高强度间歇训练（HIIT）比时间匹配的中等强度持续训练（MICT）引起了更高的通气、血流动力学和代谢需求（如更高的平均 VO₂、%HRR、血乳酸），以及更高的感知劳累度，表明 HIIT 提供了更大的生理刺激。
items.curatedReasonEn: This single-center randomized crossover trial comparing physiological responses between HIIT and MICT in early cardiac rehabilitation confirmed that HIIT elicits a greater physiological stimulus, providing evidence for tailoring personalized cardiovascular rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（18 人），且为单中心研究，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (18 participants) and is single-center, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
