items.title: Patient experiences with a prescription-based digital health application (DiGA) for knee disorders: a qualitative study in german orthopaedic care.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 10 German patients with knee disorders prescribed a digital health application (DiGA) found general openness to its use, valuing flexibility and its role in bridging physiotherapy gaps. Challenges included limited personalization, insufficient feedback, and administrative hurdles.
items.curatedReason: 虽然样本量小，但这篇定性研究提供德国骨科患者对处方数字健康应用（DiGA）的真实体验，指出了其在衔接物理治疗方面的潜力以及个性化和易用性方面仍需改进。
items.titleZh: 膝关节疾病患者处方数字健康应用 (DiGA) 的使用体验：一项德国骨科护理的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 10 名被处方数字健康应用 (DiGA) 的德国膝关节疾病患者的定性研究发现，患者普遍接受该应用，并看重其灵活性和弥补物理治疗空白的作用。挑战包括个性化不足、反馈不充分和行政障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: Despite the small sample size, this qualitative study offers real-world insights into German orthopedic patients' experiences with prescription-based digital health applications (DiGAs), highlighting their potential for bridging physiotherapy gaps while identifying areas for improvement in personalization and usability.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本定性研究，结果可能不适用于更广泛人群，且观察期较短。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample qualitative study, so the findings may not be generalizable to broader populations, and the observation period was short.

items.title: Can Clinicians Predict Which Patients Respond Best to a Specific Treatment? A Systematic Review of Low Back Pain Moderators in Primary Care.
items.summary: A systematic review of 73 studies on low back pain moderators found highly heterogeneous and inconclusive results, with most moderation analyses being of poor quality. No clearly important moderators were identified, suggesting further testing is needed before clinical recommendation.
items.curatedReason: 本系统综述强调了目前对于哪些腰痛患者对特定治疗反应最佳的证据仍然不足且质量不高，临床实践中切勿过度解读现有结果，仍需更多高质量研究来指导个体化治疗决策。
items.titleZh: 临床医生能否预测哪些患者对特定治疗反应最佳？初级保健中腰痛调节因素的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项针对腰痛调节因素的 73 项研究系统综述发现，结果高度异质且不确定，大多数调节分析质量不佳。未发现明确重要的调节因素，表明在临床推荐前需要进一步测试。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights that current evidence on which low back pain patients respond best to specific treatments is insufficient and of low quality. Clinical practice should avoid over-interpreting existing results; more high-quality research is needed to guide individualized treatment decisions.
items.limitation: 研究高度异质性，导致无法进行荟萃分析，且多数纳入研究的调节分析质量较差。
items.limitationEn: The high heterogeneity of studies precluded meta-analysis, and the quality of moderation analyses in most included studies was poor.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Benefits and limitations of robotic gait exoskeletons in functional rehabilitation of children with cerebral palsy: an umbrella review.
items.summary: An umbrella review suggests Robot-Assisted Gait Training (RAGT) may improve gross motor function (GMFM dimensions D and E) in children with cerebral palsy, but improvements in spatiotemporal gait parameters remain inconsistent. RAGT is considered a valuable adjunct to conventional rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: RAGT 确实能改善脑瘫儿童的粗大运动功能（GMFM D 和 E），但别指望它能一致地改善步态时空参数。应将 RAGT 定位为常规康复的有效补充，而非完全替代。
items.titleZh: 机器人步态外骨骼在脑瘫儿童功能康复中的益处与局限性：一项伞形综述
items.summaryZh: 一项伞形综述表明，机器人辅助步态训练 (RAGT) 可能改善脑瘫儿童的粗大运动功能（GMFM D 和 E 维度），但步态时空参数的改善仍不一致。RAGT 被认为是常规康复的有益辅助手段。
items.curatedReasonEn: RAGT can improve gross motor function (GMFM D and E) in children with cerebral palsy, but don't expect consistent improvements in spatiotemporal gait parameters. Position RAGT as a valuable adjunct to conventional rehabilitation, not a replacement.
items.limitation: 本伞形综述中各研究的疗效异质性较高，且仅分析了特定的步态参数和 GMFM-88 结果。
items.limitationEn: The efficacy across studies in this umbrella review was highly heterogeneous, and only specific gait parameters and GMFM-88 outcomes were analyzed.

items.title: Immediate task-specific and delayed generalized adaptations to variable dual-task training in community-dwelling older adults: a randomized waitlist-controlled trial
items.summary: A 12-week variable dual-task training program for older adults (n=50) led to immediate gains in functional lower-limb strength (5xSTS: SMD = 0.54) and delayed improvements in functional mobility, inhibitory control, and short-term memory at 3-month follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验表明，多变双任务训练（variable dual-task training）能立即提高老年人的下肢功能力量，并在3个月内带来功能流动性、抑制性控制和短期记忆的延迟改善。这提示将多变双任务训练纳入老年康复方案，可能对认知和运动功能产生更广泛、更持久的益处。
items.titleZh: 社区居住老年人多变双任务训练后任务特异性即时适应和延迟泛化适应：一项随机候补对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对社区居住老年人（n=50）的12周多变双任务训练项目，导致下肢功能力量立即增强（5xSTS: SMD = 0.54），并在3个月随访时出现功能流动性、抑制性控制和短期记忆的延迟改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial demonstrates that variable dual-task training immediately improves functional lower-limb strength in older adults, with delayed improvements in functional mobility, inhibitory control, and short-term memory emerging over 3 months. This suggests that incorporating variable dual-task training into geriatric rehabilitation programs could yield broader and more lasting benefits for both cognitive and motor function.
items.limitation: 研究中的一些认知和运动结局仅在随访期而非干预后立即显现改善，提示需进一步探索这些延迟效应的机制和临床意义。
items.limitationEn: Some cognitive and motor outcomes showed improvements only at follow-up, not immediately post-intervention, suggesting a need to further explore the mechanisms and clinical significance of these delayed effects.

items.title: Effectiveness of wearable and non-wearable biofeedback on knee biomechanics during functional tasks in anterior cruciate ligament injury prevention and rehabilitation: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis found that biofeedback interventions significantly reduced peak knee abduction angle (Hedges’ g = 0.52, 95% CI 0.06 to 0.98) in ACL injury prevention, but the certainty of evidence was low to very low, with no significant effects on other knee biomechanics.
items.curatedReason: 生物反馈在ACL损伤预防中可能有助于减少膝关节外翻角度，但这只是初步提示，证据质量低到非常低。我们不能就此断定生物反馈能真正降低ACL损伤率。在临床中，我们仍需谨慎，应等待更高质量的RCT来评估其对实际损伤结果而非生物力学替代指标的长期效果，再考虑常规推荐。
items.titleZh: 可穿戴和非可穿戴生物反馈对前交叉韧带损伤预防和康复中膝关节生物力学有效性的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析发现，生物反馈干预显著降低了前交叉韧带损伤预防中的膝关节外展峰值角度（Hedges’ g = 0.52, 95% CI 0.06 至 0.98），但证据确定性为低到非常低，对其他膝关节生物力学无显著影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Biofeedback may help reduce peak knee abduction angle in ACL injury prevention, but this is a preliminary suggestion based on low to very low certainty evidence. We cannot conclude that biofeedback truly reduces ACL injury rates. Clinically, we must remain cautious and await higher-quality RCTs that evaluate its long-term effects on actual injury outcomes, rather than just biomechanical surrogates, before considering widespread recommendation.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的大部分是预防性研究，且证据总体确定性为低至非常低，限制了对临床实践的直接指导。
items.limitationEn: Most included studies were prevention-focused, and the overall certainty of evidence was low to very low, limiting direct clinical practice guidance.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The development and psychometric evaluation of the Post Activity Symptom Scale (PASS) for Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/ Chronic Fatigue Syndrome.
items.summary: A new scale, the Post Activity Symptom Scale (PASS), was developed and psychometrically evaluated for measuring post-exertional malaise in people with ME/CFS, showing excellent test-retest reliability (ICC = 0.81) and moderate criterion-related validity (r=0.58).
items.curatedReason: 对于评估肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征 (ME/CFS) 患者的运动后不适（PEM），我们现在有了一个有前景的新工具：Post Activity Symptom Scale (PASS)。该量表展现出良好的重测信度 (ICC = 0.81) 和中等效度 (r=0.58)，有望在临床和研究中更准确地衡量患者的功能状态和治疗效果。
items.titleZh: 肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征运动后症状量表 (PASS) 的开发和心理测量学评估
items.summaryZh: 一项新量表——运动后症状量表（PASS）——被开发并进行了心理测量学评估，用于衡量肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征患者的运动后不适，结果显示出优秀的重测信度（ICC = 0.81）和中等的准则相关效度（r=0.58）。
items.curatedReasonEn: We now have a promising new tool for assessing post-exertional malaise (PEM) in people with ME/CFS: the Post Activity Symptom Scale (PASS). This scale shows good test-retest reliability (ICC = 0.81) and moderate validity (r=0.58), offering the potential for more accurate measurement of functional status and treatment effects in both clinical practice and research.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且主要针对健康成人，其在其他临床人群中的适用性尚待评估。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size is relatively small, focusing primarily on healthy adults, and its applicability to other clinical populations requires further evaluation.

items.title: Feasibility of an interprofessional rehabilitation program (IPRehab-LBP) for people with chronic low back pain in Ethiopia: an open-label pilot randomized controlled trial with an embedded process evaluation
items.summary: A pilot RCT in Ethiopia found an interprofessional rehabilitation program (IPRehab-LBP) for chronic low back pain to be feasible and acceptable, reducing disability (RMDQ mean difference, -6.29; 95% CI, -9.69 to -2.89) compared to usual care.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步随机对照试验支持埃塞俄比亚慢性腰痛跨专业康复项目 (IPRehab-LBP) 的可行性。其有效减少残疾评分（RMDQ 平均差异 -6.29），提示在资源有限地区，跨专业团队的综合方案能带来临床效益。可以借鉴其方法学去设计和实施针对类似人群的康复项目。
items.titleZh: 埃塞俄比亚慢性腰痛跨专业康复项目 (IPRehab-LBP) 的可行性：一项开放标签初步随机对照试验及内嵌过程评估
items.summaryZh: 一项在埃塞俄比亚进行的初步随机对照试验发现，针对慢性腰痛的跨专业康复项目 (IPRehab-LBP) 是可行且可接受的，与常规护理相比，它能减轻残疾（RMDQ 平均差异为 -6.29；95% CI -9.69 至 -2.89）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT supports the feasibility of the Interprofessional Rehabilitation Program for Chronic Low Back Pain (IPRehab-LBP) in Ethiopia. Its significant reduction in disability scores (RMDQ mean difference -6.29) suggests that comprehensive interprofessional approaches can yield clinical benefits in low-resource settings. Clinicians can draw on its methodology to design and implement similar rehabilitation programs for comparable populations.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的开放标签随机对照试验，结果偏向可行性评估，并非大规模疗效验证，且有招聘率和部分依从性未达预设标准。
items.limitationEn: This is an open-label pilot RCT primarily focused on feasibility, not large-scale efficacy validation. It also reported not meeting pre-specified recruitment rates and some fidelity criteria.

items.title: Effectiveness and cost-effectiveness of a multidisciplinary programme compared to usual care for people with low back pain in Belgium
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study in Belgium found that a standard multidisciplinary rehabilitation pathway was more cost-effective for workers with low back pain than a federal-funded pathway or usual care, with the federal pathway associated with higher costs (€7374) and longer disability (~111 days).
items.curatedReason: 别盲目相信“联邦资助”就一定好。比利时这项回顾性队列研究清楚地提示我们，标准的多学科康复（MBR）路径在成本效益上优于联邦资助的FEDRIS路径和常规护理。特别是联邦路径，其成本更高（7374欧元）且导致更长的残疾期（约111天）。这意味着，在设计腰痛康复项目时，必须警惕过度投入而收效甚微的情况。
items.titleZh: 比利时多学科康复项目与常规护理对腰痛患者的有效性和成本效益比较
items.summaryZh: 一项比利时回顾性队列研究发现，对腰痛工人而言，标准多学科康复路径比联邦资助路径或常规护理更具成本效益，其中联邦路径与更高的成本（7374欧元）和更长的致残期（约111天）相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Don't blindly assume 'federally funded' means better. This retrospective cohort study from Belgium clearly suggests that a standard multidisciplinary rehabilitation (MBR) pathway is more cost-effective for low back pain than the federal-funded FEDRIS pathway or usual care. Specifically, the federal pathway was associated with higher costs (€7374) and longer disability (~111 days). This is a strong reminder that when designing low back pain rehabilitation programs, we must be cautious about over-investment yielding minimal returns.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，数据来自行政数据库，存在潜在的混杂因素和选择偏倚，可能影响结果的因果推断。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cohort study using administrative database data, which may be subject to confounding and selection bias, potentially affecting causal inferences.

items.title: Digital handgrip assessment in musculoskeletal health: reliability, measurement precision, interchangeability, and clinical implications for rehabilitation and sports medicine
items.summary: Three digital handgrip dynamometers showed excellent test-retest reliability (ICC = 0.88–0.95), but limited interchangeability due to systematic differences in absolute force values (GripAble produced 26.37–30.47% lower values). K-Force showed the lowest SEM (1.36–1.63 kg).
items.curatedReason: 测量握力时，千万别混用数字握力计！尽管这些设备都有出色的重测信度（ICC = 0.88–0.95），但它们之间存在显著的系统性差异，例如 GripAble 的读数比其他设备低了 26.37–30.47%。这意味着，你在追踪患者进展时，必须始终使用同一设备，否则数据无法准确比较。同时，务必参考各设备的最小可检测变化值（MDC 95：3.77-5.87 kg）来判断真正的变化。
items.titleZh: 数字握力评估在肌肉骨骼健康中的应用：可靠性、测量精度、互换性及对康复和运动医学的临床意义
items.summaryZh: 三款数字握力计显示出优秀的重测信度（ICC = 0.88–0.95），但由于绝对力量值的系统性差异（GripAble 的读数比其他产品低 26.37–30.47%），互换性有限。K-Force 的 SEM 最低（1.36–1.63 kg）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Never mix digital handgrip dynamometers when measuring grip strength! While these devices show excellent test-retest reliability (ICC = 0.88–0.95), there are significant systematic differences between them; for example, GripAble consistently reads 26.37–30.47% lower than others. This means you must use the same device consistently when tracking patient progress, otherwise your data will not be comparable. Always refer to the device-specific minimal detectable change (MDC 95: 3.77-5.87 kg) to interpret true changes.
items.limitation: 研究仅纳入了25名健康成人，其结果在运动人群和临床患者中的适用性尚待验证。
items.limitationEn: The study included only 25 healthy adults, and its findings' applicability to athletic and clinical populations still needs to be validated.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Post-discharge home-based rehabilitation for frail older adults a scoping review of environmental support strategies for functional recovery and aging-in-place
items.summary: A scoping review of 10 studies on post-discharge home-based rehabilitation for frail older adults identified home-based rehabilitation as the core component, supplemented by environmental support strategies including home assessment, modification, assistive devices, caregiver support, and service coordination.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述系统梳理了出院后居家康复中环境支持策略的证据，明确了居家康复是核心，辅以家庭评估、改造、辅助设备、照护者支持和服务协调。它为居家康复方案的设计提供了框架，但提醒我们，单一环境支持策略的独立贡献尚不明确，未来需更精细的研究。
items.titleZh: 出院后居家康复对衰弱老年人的环境支持策略范围综述：功能恢复和就地养老
items.summaryZh: 一项针对衰弱老年人出院后居家康复的10项研究的范围综述发现，居家康复是核心组成部分，辅以环境支持策略，包括家庭评估、改造、辅助设备、照护者支持和服务协调。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review systematically mapped evidence on environmental support strategies in post-discharge home-based rehabilitation, identifying home-based rehabilitation as core, supplemented by home assessment, modification, assistive devices, caregiver support, and service coordination. It provides a framework for designing home-based rehabilitation programs, but highlights that the individual contributions of specific environmental support strategies remain unclear, warranting more refined future research.
items.limitation: 作为范围综述，未对研究质量进行正式评估，且许多环境支持策略作为多组分干预提供，难以区分单一策略的独立效应。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, no formal critical appraisal of study quality was undertaken, and many environmental support strategies were delivered as multicomponent interventions, making it difficult to isolate the independent effects of single strategies.

items.title: Surgical techniques for swan neck finger deformity correction
items.summary: This review provides a detailed definition of swan neck finger deformity and summarizes available treatment options, from conservative splinting to various surgical techniques.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述详细定义了天鹅颈指畸形，并概述了保守夹板固定到多种手术矫正方案。虽然它为理解这种复杂畸形提供了基础，但作为一篇叙述性综述，它并未提供具体的循证治疗推荐，更多是知识的梳理。
items.titleZh: 天鹅颈指畸形矫正手术技术
items.summaryZh: 本综述详细定义了天鹅颈指畸形，并总结了从保守夹板固定到各种手术矫正技术在内的可用治疗方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review provides a detailed definition of swan neck finger deformity and outlines treatment options ranging from conservative splinting to various surgical corrections. While it offers a foundational understanding of this complex deformity, as a narrative review, it does not provide specific evidence-based treatment recommendations, primarily serving as a knowledge compilation.
items.limitation: 本综述未进行系统性检索和质量评估，因此无法提供明确的治疗推荐，更多是对手术技术和治疗策略的概述。
items.limitationEn: This review did not conduct a systematic search or quality appraisal, thus it cannot provide definitive treatment recommendations, serving more as an overview of surgical techniques and treatment strategies.

items.title: Physical Therapy in the News: October 2026
items.summary: APTA's "Physical Therapy in the News: October 2026" is a monthly series highlighting recent media coverage of the profession and its members.
items.curatedReason: APTA 每月发布一次的“新闻中的物理治疗”总结了媒体对物理治疗专业和 APTA 成员的报道。这可以让你快速了解当前媒体关注的焦点和行业形象。
items.titleZh: 新闻中的物理治疗：2026 年 10 月 | APTA
items.summaryZh: APTA 的“2026 年 10 月物理治疗新闻”是一个每月系列，重点报道了物理治疗专业及其成员最近的媒体曝光。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA's monthly "Physical Therapy in the News" summarizes media coverage of the physical therapy profession and APTA members. This allows you to quickly gauge current media focus and the industry's public image.

items.title: Early Prediction of Discharge Outcomes in Geriatric Rehabilitation: Development and Temporal Validation of a Multiclass Model
items.summary: A multiclass model was developed and temporally validated to predict three mutually exclusive discharge outcomes (minimal dependency, nursing-care dependency, or medical deterioration) in geriatric rehabilitation patients by day 7, achieving an AUC of 0.81 for multinomial regression.
items.curatedReason: 这个模型提示，对老年康复患者，在入院第 7 天预测其出院转归是可行的，AUC 为 0.81。这意味着你可以更早地识别那些可能需要更多护理或存在医疗恶化风险的患者，从而及时启动社工介入或加强监护。
items.titleZh: 老年康复出院结局的早期预测：多分类模型的开发与时序验证
items.summaryZh: 一项研究开发并时序验证了一个多分类模型，可在老年康复患者入院第 7 天预测三种互斥的出院结局（最低依赖、护理依赖或医学恶化），多项式回归模型 AUC 达到 0.81。
items.curatedReasonEn: This model suggests that predicting discharge outcomes for geriatric rehabilitation patients by day 7 of admission is feasible, with an AUC of 0.81. This implies you could identify patients at higher risk of nursing-care dependency or medical deterioration earlier, allowing for timely social work intervention or intensified monitoring.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，且仅在一个公共老年康复医院进行，结果的外推性有待前瞻性多中心验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study conducted in a single public geriatric rehabilitation hospital, and the generalizability of the findings requires prospective multi-center validation.

items.title: A COSMIN systematic review of performance-based assessment tools for mealtime performance in Parkinson's disease: a linking study based on the ICF framework.
items.summary: A systematic review identified only two performance-based outcome measures for mealtime performance in Parkinson's disease, the Mealtime Assessment Scale (MAS) and modified OARS scale, finding the MAS covered more ICF components but neither had independent content validity testing. The evidence base remains limited and preliminary.
items.curatedReason: 现有证据对帕金森病患者餐时表现的评估工具非常有限。在 ICF 框架下，餐时评估量表（MAS）覆盖度较广，但内容效度仍需独立验证。你在临床中应更关注餐时表现的多维度，而非仅仅吞咽。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病患者餐时表现评估工具的 COSMIN 系统综述：基于 ICF 框架的关联研究
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述发现，帕金森病餐时表现的客观评估工具仅有餐时评估量表（MAS）和改良版 OARS 量表两项。MAS 覆盖了 ICF 的所有四个组成部分，但两项工具均缺乏独立内容效度验证，现有证据基础有限且初步。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence for mealtime performance assessment tools in Parkinson's disease is very limited. Within the ICF framework, the Mealtime Assessment Scale (MAS) has broad coverage, but its content validity still requires independent validation. Clinically, you should focus on multi-dimensional aspects of mealtime performance, beyond just swallowing.
items.limitation: 本系统综述仅纳入了两项研究，证据基础非常有限且初步。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review included only two studies, indicating a very limited and preliminary evidence base.

items.title: Interval Between Injury and Surgery Influences Knee Biomechanics During Walking in Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstructed Patients: A Systematic Review with Meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 16 studies (18-55 years) found ACLR patients have lower peak knee flexion angle (SMD = -0.33), peak knee adduction angle (SMD = -0.47), and peak knee flexion moment (SMD = -0.64) during walking. Delayed reconstruction (≥ 12 months) is associated with persistent sagittal plane deficits, while early surgery (< 6 months) is linked to fewer long-term sagittal-plane deficits but temporary frontal-plane asymmetries and extension deficits.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述明确指出，ACL 重建术（ACLR）后步态生物力学异常与伤后至手术间隔时间有关。长期延迟手术（≥ 12 个月）与持续性矢状面缺陷相关，而早期手术（< 6 个月）虽早期有额状面不对称和伸展缺陷，但长期矢状面缺陷较少。你规划 ACLR 患者康复时，必须考虑手术时机，针对性地调整康复策略，尤其是对于延迟手术的患者，需更多关注其矢状面功能的恢复。
items.titleZh: 伤后至手术间隔时间影响前交叉韧带重建患者步行时的膝关节生物力学：一项系统综述与 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 16 项研究（18-55 岁）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，ACL 重建患者在步行时表现出较低的膝关节屈曲峰值角度（SMD = -0.33）、内收峰值角度（SMD = -0.47）和屈曲峰值力矩（SMD = -0.64）。延迟重建（≥ 12 个月）与持续性矢状面缺陷相关，而早期手术（< 6 个月）与较少的长期矢状面缺陷相关，但可能伴有暂时的额状面不对称和伸展缺陷。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review clarifies that altered walking biomechanics post-ACLR are related to the interval between injury and surgery. Delayed surgery (≥ 12 months) is associated with persistent sagittal plane deficits, while early surgery (< 6 months) shows fewer long-term sagittal plane deficits despite early frontal plane asymmetries and extension deficits. When planning rehabilitation for ACLR patients, you must consider surgical timing to tailor strategies, particularly focusing on sagittal plane recovery for those with delayed surgery.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学质量中等（平均 65%），且存在高异质性（I² ≥ 57%），这可能影响了结果的确定性和推断强度。
items.limitationEn: The included studies had moderate methodological quality (average 65%) and high heterogeneity (I² ≥ 57%), which may affect the certainty and strength of the conclusions.

items.title: Physiotherapy and Exercise-Based Rehabilitation for Mental Health: A Two-Decade Bibliometric Analysis of Global Trends, Thematic Evolution, and the Socioeconomic Vulnerability Gap (2006-2025).
items.summary: A bibliometric analysis of 5223 publications (2006-2025) on physical rehabilitation and mental health showed a 22.6-fold increase in publications. Research is concentrated in high-income countries (75.9%), with socioeconomic vulnerability explicitly referenced in only 4.6% of publications, highlighting it as an under-researched area.
items.curatedReason: 这项文献计量分析显示，物理治疗和运动康复在精神健康领域的文献量显著增长，但研究重心仍高度集中在高收入国家。它提醒你，在规划研究或寻求资助时，应关注低收入环境、成本效益评估和实施科学，以填补社会经济脆弱性这一关键且尚未充分探索的空白，确保研究成果能转化为更公平的干预措施。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗和运动康复对精神健康的影响：一项全球趋势、主题演变和社会经济脆弱性差距的二十年文献计量分析（2006-2025）
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 5223 份关于物理康复与精神健康的出版物（2006-2025 年）的文献计量分析显示，出版量增长了 22.6 倍。研究主要集中在高收入国家（75.9%），仅有 4.6% 的出版物明确提及社会经济脆弱性，凸显其为一个尚未充分研究的领域。
items.curatedReasonEn: This bibliometric analysis shows substantial growth in physical therapy and exercise rehabilitation literature for mental health, yet research remains concentrated in high-income countries. It prompts you to focus on low-resource settings, cost-effectiveness evaluations, and implementation science when planning research or seeking funding, to address the critical and underexplored gap of socioeconomic vulnerability and ensure equitable interventions.
items.limitation: 文献计量学研究的局限性在于其结果依赖于关键词和数据库检索策略，可能无法捕捉所有相关研究，尤其是在未明确标记社会经济脆弱性的研究中。此外，对2026年数据的纳入，作为预测而非实际已发表数据，也可能带来偏差。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of bibliometric studies is their reliance on keywords and database search strategies, which may not capture all relevant research, especially those not explicitly tagged with socioeconomic vulnerability. Additionally, the inclusion of 2026 data as projections rather than actual published data may introduce bias.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Experiences of physiotherapists in managing pelvic floor disorders at public hospitals in uThukela district, South Africa.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 12 physiotherapists in South Africa's uThukela district identified limited undergraduate training, inadequate resources, understaffing, and poor referral pathways as barriers to managing pelvic floor disorders in public hospitals.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了南非公立医院物理治疗师在管理盆底障碍（PFD）方面面临的挑战，如本科培训不足、资源匮乏、人员不足及转诊路径不畅。这些发现可指导当地改善教育和资源分配，但其区域性限制了普遍适用性。
items.titleZh: 南非 uThukela 地区公立医院物理治疗师管理盆底障碍的经验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对南非 uThukela 地区 12 名物理治疗师的定性研究发现，本科培训不足、资源匮乏、人员不足和转诊路径不畅是公立医院管理盆底障碍（PFDs）的障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights challenges faced by physiotherapists in managing pelvic floor disorders (PFDs) in South African public hospitals, including insufficient undergraduate training, limited resources, understaffing, and poor referral pathways. These findings can guide local improvements in education and resource allocation, though their regional specificity limits universal applicability.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性描述性研究，样本量小（12 名物理治疗师），结果主要反映南非 uThukela 地区的特定背景，外推至其他地区或国家的适用性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative descriptive study with a small sample (12 physiotherapists) primarily reflects the specific context of the uThukela district in South Africa, limiting its generalizability to other regions or countries.
items.journal: The South African journal of physiotherapy

items.title: Health-seeking behaviours of people with osteoarthritis in sub-Saharan Africa: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of five studies from sub-Saharan Africa found that health-seeking behavior for osteoarthritis is largely delayed or fragmented, influenced by intrapersonal, interpersonal, organizational, and community factors, highlighting barriers like beliefs, poor knowledge, and limited access to rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述揭示了撒哈拉以南非洲骨关节炎患者求医行为受文化信仰、健康素养和医疗系统多重影响。它提醒你，在低收入地区执业时，需要加强患者教育、推广自我管理和拓展社区康复，同时改进转诊路径，以应对延迟就医和康复服务可及性差的现状。
items.titleZh: 撒哈拉以南非洲骨关节炎患者的健康寻求行为：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项针对撒哈拉以南非洲五项研究的范围综述发现，骨关节炎患者的健康寻求行为普遍延迟或碎片化，受个体、人际、组织和社区因素影响，突出表现为信念、知识匮乏和康复服务可及性受限等障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review reveals that health-seeking behaviors of people with osteoarthritis in sub-Saharan Africa are influenced by cultural beliefs, health literacy, and healthcare systems. It reminds you to enhance patient education, promote self-management, expand community-based rehabilitation, and improve referral pathways when practicing in low-resource settings, addressing delayed help-seeking and limited access to rehabilitation services.
items.limitation: 本范围综述仅纳入 5 项研究，且全部来自农村地区，代表性有限，可能未能全面反映撒哈拉以南非洲地区骨关节炎患者的健康寻求行为。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review included only 5 studies, all from rural settings, limiting its representativeness and potentially not fully capturing health-seeking behaviors of people with osteoarthritis across sub-Saharan Africa.
items.journal: The South African journal of physiotherapy

items.title: Comparative Effects of Neurostimulation- and Technology-Augmented Robot-Assisted Training on Upper-Limb Motor Recovery After Stroke: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis of 103 trials (N = 5,251) found rTMS plus robot-assisted training (RAT) yielded the largest FMA-UE estimate (MD 9.56 points), followed by LFES plus RAT (MD 7.52) compared to usual care, with RAT alone showing smaller gains (MD 3.83).
items.curatedReason: 这项网络荟萃分析指出，结合重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）或低频电刺激（LFES）的机器人辅助训练，比单纯机器人辅助训练更能显著改善卒中后上肢运动功能。这提示你可以在现有机器人康复方案中，积极考虑纳入神经调控技术以期获得更优疗效。
items.titleZh: 神经刺激与技术增强型机器人辅助训练对卒中后上肢运动恢复的比较效应：一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 103 项试验（N=5,251）的系统综述和网络荟萃分析发现，与常规护理相比，重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）结合机器人辅助训练（RAT）对上肢富格尔-梅耶评估（FMA-UE）改善最大（平均差 9.56 分），其次是低频电刺激（LFES）结合 RAT（平均差 7.52 分），单纯 RAT 改善较小（平均差 3.83 分）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network meta-analysis suggests that robot-assisted training combined with rTMS or LFES significantly improves upper-limb motor recovery post-stroke compared to robot-assisted training alone. This indicates you might proactively consider integrating neuromodulation techniques into existing robotic rehabilitation protocols for better outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究存在显著异质性且头对头证据稀少，加上证据确定性为非常低到中等，尚不能得出明确的干预优先级。
items.limitationEn: The study has substantial heterogeneity and sparse head-to-head evidence, combined with very low-to-moderate certainty, precluding a definitive hierarchy of interventions.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Inertial measurement unit-based gait analysis for objective assessment of vestibular rehabilitation.
items.summary: An observational study of 30 AVS participants found that IMU-based gait analysis, even with a single pelvis sensor, captured significant improvements in walking speed, Gait Profile Score, and cadence after 6 weeks of vestibular rehabilitation, supporting its clinical feasibility for assessment.
items.curatedReason: IMU 传感器（包括单传感器）在急性前庭综合征（AVS）患者的步态分析中展现出良好的可行性，可作为评估前庭康复进展的客观工具。这提示你可以考虑将可穿戴设备纳入日常评估，以量化患者的进步。
items.titleZh: 基于惯性测量单元的步态分析对前庭康复的客观评估
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 30 名急性前庭综合征患者的观察性研究发现，即使是单骨盆 IMU 传感器也能捕捉到前庭康复 6 周后步行速度、步态姿态评分和步频的显著改善，支持其作为康复评估的临床可行性。
items.curatedReasonEn: IMU sensors, including single-sensor setups, demonstrate good feasibility for gait analysis in patients with acute vestibular syndrome (AVS) and can serve as objective tools for assessing vestibular rehabilitation progress. This suggests you could consider incorporating wearable devices into your routine assessments to quantify patient improvement.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量相对较小（30 例 AVS 患者），且缺乏长期随访数据来评估 IMU 在更长时间康复效果中的表现。
items.limitationEn: This study has a relatively small sample size (30 AVS participants) and lacks long-term follow-up data to evaluate IMU performance in assessing rehabilitation outcomes over extended periods.

items.title: Midlife mobility assessment from the pocket: agreement and consistency between smartphone placement configurations
items.summary: A study of 46 adults (aged 40-64) found strong correlations and good-to-excellent consistency for balance, sit-to-stand repetition count, and Timed Up and Go total duration between smartphone placements at the lower back and pocket/thigh, supporting practical midlife mobility assessment.
items.curatedReason: 智能手机放在口袋或大腿位置进行平衡、坐站和计时起立行走测试，其结果与标准下背部放置的测量结果高度一致，尤其是重复次数和总时长。这提示你可在临床实践中探索更便捷的智能手机移动性评估方式，提高评估依从性和居家监测潜力。
items.titleZh: 从口袋评估中年移动性：智能手机放置配置之间的一致性和连贯性
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 46 名（40-64 岁）成年人的研究发现，智能手机在下背部与口袋/大腿位置的平衡、坐站重复次数和计时起立行走总时长测量结果之间具有强相关性和良好至极佳的一致性，支持其在中年移动性评估中的实际应用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Smartphone placement in the pocket or on the thigh for balance, sit-to-stand, and Timed Up and Go tests shows high agreement with standard lower-back placement, especially for repetition counts and total duration. This suggests you can explore more convenient smartphone-based mobility assessments in clinical practice to improve adherence and home monitoring potential.
items.limitation: 某些运动衍生指标（如坐站功率和最大垂直速度）在不同放置位置间相关性较弱，可能需要进一步验证才能推广应用。
items.limitationEn: Some movement-derived measures (e.g., STS power and maximal vertical velocity) showed weaker correlations between different placements, which may require further validation before widespread application.

items.title: Effects of chair-based exercise training on pulmonary function, exercise capacity, and quality of life in patients with acute exacerbation of COPD: A randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=30) found that chair-based exercise training in patients hospitalized with acute COPD exacerbations significantly improved functional exercise capacity (mean 6MWT distance change 50.9 m [95% CI 2.09-99.76]; p=0.042), dyspnea, and quality of life compared to breathing exercises alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 坐实了在 COPD 急性加重期住院期间进行椅上运动训练是可行的，并且能显著改善患者的功能运动能力（6MWT 距离改善 50.9 米）、呼吸困难和生活质量。这提示你应该把椅上运动纳入 COPD 住院患者的常规康复方案。
items.titleZh: 椅上运动训练对急性加重期 COPD 患者肺功能、运动能力和生活质量的影响：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=30）发现，对急性加重期 COPD 住院患者进行椅上运动训练，功能运动能力（6MWT 距离平均改善 50.9 米 [95% CI 2.09-99.76]；p=0.042）、呼吸困难和生活质量均显著优于单独进行呼吸训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms that chair-based exercise training is feasible during hospitalization for acute COPD exacerbations and significantly improves functional exercise capacity (6MWT distance improved by 50.9 m), dyspnea, and quality of life. This suggests you should integrate chair-based exercise into routine rehabilitation protocols for hospitalized COPD patients.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，限制了结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The small sample size limits the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Effects of low-dose cervical paraspinal lidocaine injections on cervicogenic dizziness-related outcomes: a randomized, sham-controlled, assessor-blinded trial.
items.summary: A randomized, sham-controlled trial (n=81) found low-dose cervical paraspinal lidocaine injections improved Dizziness Handicap Inventory total score by -6.78 points (95% CI -8.21 to -5.36; p < 0.001) in cervicogenic dizziness, which was statistically significant but below the 11-point minimal important change.
items.curatedReason: 低剂量颈椎旁利多卡因注射液虽能统计学显著改善颈源性眩晕的DHI总分，但-6.78分的改善量低于11分的最小临床重要变化。别指望它能带来实质性的临床改善，更不应替代主动康复，但它提示多模式干预中这一方法的有限作用。
items.titleZh: 低剂量颈椎旁利多卡因注射对颈源性眩晕相关结局的影响：一项随机、假对照、评估者盲法试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机、假对照试验（n=81）发现，低剂量颈椎旁利多卡因注射可使颈源性眩晕患者的眩晕残疾量表总分改善 -6.78 分（95% CI -8.21 至 -5.36；p < 0.001），统计学意义显著，但低于 11 分的最小临床重要改变。
items.curatedReasonEn: While low-dose cervical paraspinal lidocaine injections statistically significantly improved DHI scores in cervicogenic dizziness, the -6.78 point improvement falls short of the 11-point minimal clinically important change. Do not expect substantial clinical improvement from this intervention, and certainly do not substitute it for active rehabilitation. This highlights the limited role of such an approach within multimodal interventions.
items.limitation: 该试验没有验证受试者盲法，且缺乏长期随访，也未与康复干预相结合进行评估。
items.limitationEn: The trial did not verify participant blinding, lacked long-term follow-up, and was not evaluated in conjunction with rehabilitation interventions.

items.title: Efficacy of real-time feedback exercise therapy in patients following total hip arthroplasty: a pilot cluster-randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A pilot cluster-randomized controlled trial with 22 patients found that real-time feedback-assisted home exercise after THA did not significantly differ from standard written instructions in improving function or quality of life, but the intervention group reported greater motivation and self-confidence.
items.curatedReason: 对于全髋关节置换术（THA）术后患者，实时反馈辅助家庭锻炼在改善功能和生活质量方面并未显示出优于标准书面指导的显著差异。但注意它提示了患者有更高的动机和信心。
items.titleZh: 全髋关节置换术后患者实时反馈运动疗法的疗效：一项试点集群随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 22 名患者进行的试点集群随机对照试验发现，全髋关节置换术（THA）后实时反馈辅助家庭锻炼在改善功能和生活质量方面与标准书面指导无显著差异，但干预组报告了更高的动机和自信。
items.curatedReasonEn: Real-time feedback-assisted home exercise did not show significant differences in improving function and quality of life compared to standard written instructions for patients after total hip arthroplasty (THA). However, it did suggest higher patient motivation and confidence.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的试点试验，且患者对干预的盲法未经验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample pilot trial, and patient blinding to the intervention was not verified.

items.title: e-health in musculoskeletal primary care physiotherapy: Evidence, facilitators, and barriers - A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 45 studies found e-Health is well-received in musculoskeletal primary care physiotherapy, particularly blended care, with internet-based solutions, mobile apps, and video consultations being most common. However, patient and clinician barriers persist, highlighting the need for clear guidelines and structured training.
items.curatedReason: 这份范围综述概述了初级保健物理治疗中电子健康（e-Health）解决方案的现状，为你清晰呈现了主流技术、应用方式，以及推广中可能遇到的患者和临床医生双重障碍。它能帮你思考如何更好地将数字工具融入实践。
items.titleZh: 肌肉骨骼初级保健物理治疗中的电子健康：证据、促进因素和障碍——一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 45 项研究的范围综述发现，电子健康（e-Health）在肌肉骨骼初级保健物理治疗中（特别是混合护理）广受欢迎，以互联网解决方案、移动应用和视频咨询最为常见。但患者和临床医生面临的障碍依然存在，提示需制定明确指南和系统培训。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review outlines the current landscape of e-Health solutions in primary care physiotherapy, clearly presenting mainstream technologies, application methods, and potential patient and clinician barriers to adoption. It helps you consider how to better integrate digital tools into your practice.
items.limitation: 研究方法和电子健康模式存在异质性，且多数研究来自高收入国家，可能限制其普适性。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity in study methods and e-Health modalities, with a predominance of studies from high-income countries, may limit generalizability.
